jobs.title: Program Coordinator – Part-Time
jobs.description:
**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**Help make one\-on\-one tutoring work for Oakland children.**

Children Rising is hiring several **part\-time Program Coordinators** for the 2026–27 school year to support our literacy, math, and family engagement programs in Oakland elementary schools.

Program Coordinators are at the heart of our tutoring programs. They coordinate weekly tutoring clinics, support trained volunteer tutors working one\-on\-one with students, and help create an organized, encouraging environment where children can strengthen foundational reading and math skills.

If you enjoy working with children, are organized and encouraging, and want meaningful, hands\-on work in Oakland schools, we’d love to hear from you.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate two or more weekly tutoring clinics at Oakland school sites.
* Prepare tutoring spaces and materials so students and tutors are ready to work together.
* Pick up students from their classrooms and bring them to the tutoring clinic.
* Support volunteer tutors with scheduling, coaching, lesson planning, materials, encouragement, and student needs.
* Build positive relationships with students, tutors, families, teachers, and Children Rising staff.
* Monitor student progress and tutor\-student relationships and work with program leadership to address challenges.
* Track attendance and maintain accurate student and tutor records.
* Update program information in Salesforce.
* Collaborate with our FamilyBridge team to help connect tutoring, classroom learning, and support at home.
* Participate in program meetings, staff meetings, and special events as needed.

These responsibilities reflect the core duties in the current Children Rising job description.

**What we’re looking for**

* Two or more years of relevant education experience.
* A demonstrated ability and passion for working with children.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Experience responding constructively to student behavior and learning challenges.
* Comfort with program evaluation, data tracking, and learning new systems.
* Experience working with diverse communities.
* Experience supporting English\-language learners is a plus.
* Understanding of the impact of trauma on early\-childhood learning is a plus.

**Position details**

* Part\-time, approximately **10–20 hours per week** during the academic year.
* Work takes place primarily at Oakland school sites, with some work at the Children Rising office and remotely.
* Starting compensation is **$27/hour**, with the possibility of a higher starting rate based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated skills.
* Requires Live Scan background clearance, negative TB status, a valid driver’s license, and regular access to a car.

**About Children Rising**

Children Rising surrounds Oakland children with caring relationships and educational support so they can build stronger foundations in reading and math and greater confidence in themselves.

Through Succeeding by Reading, Path2Math, and FamilyBridge, students, families, volunteer tutors, schools, and community partners work together as part of a larger circle of care.

Job Types: Part\-time, Full\-time

Pay: From $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to complete Live Scan background clearance and provide verification of negative TB status? (Yes / No)
* Are you available to work approximately 10–20 hours per week, primarily during weekday school hours at Oakland school sites? (Yes / No)
* Do you have at least two years of experience working in education, tutoring, youth development, or a related field? (Yes/No)

Education:

* Associate (Required)

License/Certification:

* Driver's License (Required)

Work Location: In person

Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. * Run the governance layer: page request process, naming conventions, approvals, and documentation.

* Improve website accessibility (WCAG 2\.1 AA).

* Monitor uptime, broken links, form failures, and integration errors; fix or escalate.

* Work with design team and web development agencies: project scope, timelines, and quality of delivery.
* Translate business requests into clear technical requirements.
* Partner with marketing ops on forms, lead routing, and CRM handoffs so every page feeds the funnel correctly.
* Manage translation service to ensure content updates are also localized for Japanese pages.
* Report on web performance and roadmap status to marketing leadership on a regular cadence.

--------------------------


* 5\-8 years of experience managing B2B websites, ideally in tech.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Hands\-on HubSpot or WordPress CMS expertise: building and publishing, not just reviewing.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive design; enough technical depth to evaluate developer work and debug an issue.
* Analytics fluency. GA4 and Google Tag Manager, with a standard of using data to decide next steps.
* Demonstrated project management across competing stakeholders and deadlines, with the judgment to prioritize.
* Vendor and agency management experience, including project budget accountability.
* Understanding of technical SEO fundamentals, site performance, and web accessibility standards.
* Curiosity about technology, particularly AI/ML. No CS degree required, but able to understand the products well enough to represent them accurately on the site.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, Asana, and basic design or video tooling (Canva, Wistia) for fast turnarounds.

San Mateo, CA, United StatesProject ManagementID: 16239
  
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.


At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.


A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We’re looking for an International Operations Manager to drive and manage the operational cadence supporting our international structure across local country teams. You will spearhead cross\-functional execution, lead end\-to\-end work item and resource planning, and operationalize group reporting, goal\-setting, and performance tracking. In this role, you’ll build, own, and optimize the rhythms (such as QBRs, regular business reviews, and scorecards) that keep global workstreams aligned, resourced, and delivered on schedule.



This full\-time, hybrid (in\-office on Tues/Wed/Thurs) position is based in our San Mateo office and reports to the Head of International Strategy \& Ops.


### **You Will:**

* **Lead Cadence \& Operating Rhythms:** Spearhead and own internal operating cadences and reporting, including leading quarterly business reviews, establishing regular review rhythms with local international teams, and driving core alignment across regions.
* **Work Item \& Resource Planning:** Lead work item prioritization, project planning, and resource allocation across cross\-functional teams (Marketing, Comms, Trust \& Safety, Business Development, Finance, Legal) to ensure local market initiatives are properly scoped and supported.
* **Execution Management:** Oversee master project plans, timelines, and resource dependencies, actively driving follow\-ups and hold owners accountable to keep all global deliverables on track.
* Define and track core operational performance metrics and resource utilization, creating executive reporting for leadership.
* Gather inputs from country teams and XFN partners and synthesize into clear status updates, risks, and next steps.
* Lead recurring operational cadences (regional check\-ins, QBR prep, scorecards, resource allocation, and annual/quarterly planning cycles).
* Identify recurring operational gaps and implement process improvements
* Maintain and improve playbooks for repeatable workflows within local country teams across the world
* Serve as an operational point of contact between country teams and HQ partners for planning, execution, and issue triage.
* Coordinate with external vendors/agencies as needed
* Flag execution risks early (dependencies, resourcing, approvals, timelines) and help coordinate escalations to the right owners.
* Partner with Legal/Compliance/Trust \& Safety to ensure required steps are followed for market initiatives.

### **You Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **6\+ years** of experience in operations, program management, business operations, or cross\-functional project coordination.
* Experience supporting international or multi\-region teams is a plus.
* Strong project management fundamentals (planning, tracking, risk management, stakeholder updates).
* Comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize and simplify.
* Analytical and organized, with strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Familiarity with tooling such as spreadsheets, dashboards, and project trackers (e.g., Airtable, Asana/Jira) is a plus.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations Manager at Project Artaud

Reports to: Matrix structure including Executive Committee and Senior Bookkeeper  
Status: Part\-time, non\-exempt  
Compensation: $36\-45 per hour, commensurate with experience  
Benefits: Paid Sick leave, vacation/holiday pay, health insurance support, 401k plan

Hours \& Schedule: Estimated 30 hours per week across a 5\-day work week  
Location: On\-site at Project Artaud, San Francisco

ORGANIZATIONAL OVERVIEW

Project Artaud is a community\-governed artist live/work 501(c)(3\) membership organization in San Francisco dedicated to providing long\-term, low\-cost place for artists and cultural workers. The organization supports a diverse membership of resident artists and oversees a complex historic facility that requires consistent operational, administrative, and facilities coordination.

The Operations Manager plays a central role in ensuring that Project Artaud functions smoothly as both a community and an organization by overseeing daily operations, coordinating facilities\-related administration, supporting human resources and governance processes, and serving as a key point of contact for members, vendors, and partners.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Operations Manager is responsible for the coordination and administration of Project Artaud’s day\-to\-day organizational and facilities operations.

The Operations Manager works closely with the Facilities Administrator and Bookkeeper to ensure effective communication, compliance, documentation, and continuity of operations across the organization.

This position serves as a central hub for:

* Member communications and requests
* Facilities coordination and record\-keeping
* Organizational administration
* Human resources processes
* Office and systems management

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

General Operations \& Administration

* Serve as a primary point of contact for Project Artaud members, vendors, and external partners regarding operational and administrative matters
* Maintain regular office hours and ensure consistent organizational presence
* Attend at least on evening Board meeting per month
* Manage organizational calendars, schedules, and internal communications
* Receive, distribute, and track mail, deliveries, notices, and official communications
* Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems for:
* Membership records
* Board and committee documents
* Volunteer tracking
* Administrative and legal files
* Policies and procedures
* Support preparation and distribution of agendas, notices, ballots, and meeting materials for Board and Committee meetings
* Maintain confidentiality of organizational and member information
* Provide logistical support for organizational meetings and events
* Serve as the main liaison for all insurance related matters, both general liability and worker's comp and the organization’s interlocutor with the insurance broker

Facilities \& Systems Coordination (in collaboration with Facilities Administrator)

* Coordinate with the Facilities Administrator and Facilities Maintenance Manager on:
* Work order tracking and documentation
* Vendor scheduling and site access
* Emergency response coordination
* Maintain and organize records for:
* Permits and inspections
* Fire and life safety systems
* Emergency procedures
* Equipment and systems manuals
* Maintain vendor files, contracts, and service histories
* Support communication with members regarding facilities updates, construction projects, and service interruptions
* Assist with key control, space access systems (e.g., lock outs, site visits), and security coordination
* Maintain office systems, equipment, and basic IT infrastructure (computers, printers, shared drives, databases, email accounts)

Member Services \& Communications

* Respond to member inquiries related to operations, policies, and procedures
* Facilitate communication between members and appropriate committees or staff
* Coordinate access to office resources and systems
* Support internal communications such as newsletters, notices, and announcements
* Maintain bulletin boards, members\-only website, and shared information systems

Financial \& Administrative Coordination (non\-bookkeeping)

(In coordination with the Senior Bookkeeper and Treasurer)

* Gather and organize documentation for accounts payable and receivable
* Track and route invoices and purchase orders for approval
* Assist with preparation of reports and information requests
* Support annual audits and required filings through record organization
* Ensure financial procedures are followed (without performing bookkeeping functions)
* Perform additional administrative duties as directed by the Executive Committee

Systems, Documentation \& Continuous Improvement

* Maintain and update operations manuals and procedures
* Maintain and manage software subscriptions and updates
* Identify opportunities to improve internal systems, workflows, and recordkeeping
* Support implementation of new operational tools and platforms
* Train staff and committee members on operational systems as needed

QUALIFICATIONS

* Strong organizational and administrative skills with attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills with diverse stakeholders
* Experience in nonprofit, cooperative, or community\-based organizations preferred

jobs.title: Silicon Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Etched**
================


Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Production Planning \& Scheduling**
-------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain end\-to\-end production schedules for silicon wafers, interposers, and test/assembly, supporting phases from engineering builds to mass production.
* Coordinate with foundries, OSATs (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test providers), and internal stakeholders to ensure production milestones and quality goals are met.
* Collaborate with test engineering teams to coordinate ATE test program development, bring\-up planning, and bench validation hardware readiness.
* Track and forecast capacity planning across all silicon manufacturing stages, including wafer fabrication, component procurement, assembly, and test.

**Supply Chain Coordination**
-----------------------------

* Manage the procurement, delivery, and scheduling of key silicon components (e.g., wafers, interposers, substrates) to ensure optimal time\-to\-market.
* Act as the operational lead between internal teams and suppliers, ensuring transparency and alignment across silicon, packaging, validation, and manufacturing.
* Prepare for mass production ramp by ensuring material readiness, test infrastructure availability, and logistic support to mitigate bottlenecks or delays.

**Forecasting \& Reporting**
----------------------------

* Build and maintain demand forecasts for silicon and related components, based on build plans, yield assumptions, validation schedules, and market dynamics.
* Share regular forecasts with supply chain partners and ensure proactive capacity allocation at foundries and OSATs.
* Generate and maintain detailed dashboards and reports to track schedule adherence, capacity utilization, inventory status, and delivery performance for executive and technical stakeholders.

**You may be a good fit if you have**
=====================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in supply chain management, production planning, or operations within the semiconductor industry.
* Deep understanding of the silicon lifecycle: tape\-out, fabrication, packaging, test, bring\-up, and validation
* Proven track record working with foundries (TSMC, Samsung, etc.) and OSATs (ASE, Amkor, JCET, etc.).
* Willingness to travel up to 25% for onsite supplier engagement, engineering builds, and production ramp support.
* Strong understanding of: Silicon manufacturing processes, including wafer fabrication, dicing, bumping, CoWoS packaging, and testing;
* Proficiency in using ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel skills or analytics tools.
* Experience with hardware validation cycles and managing silicon hardware logistics.
* Exceptional program management and organizational skills with the ability to handle complex timelines and interdependencies.
* Effective communicator and cross\-functional leader across engineering, validation, and operations teams.

**Strong candidates may also have**
===================================

* Experience working on advanced process nodes (e.g., 5nm, 3nm).
* Familiarity with ATE platforms (Teradyne, Advantest) and test program infrastructure.
* Prior experience managing silicon bring\-up in hyperscale computing, AI/ML, or high\-performance SoC environments.
* PMP certification or equivalent project/program management training.
* Familiarity with CoWoS or other 2\.5D/3D packaging technologies.

**Benefits**

* Full medical, dental, and vision packages, with generous premium coverage
* Housing subsidy of **$2,500/month** for those living within walking distance of the office
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row)

**How we’re different**


Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We think most of the progress in the AI field has come from using more FLOPs to train and run models, and the best way to get more FLOPs is to build model\-specific hardware. Larger and larger training runs encourage companies to consolidate around fewer model architectures, which creates a market for single\-model ASICs.


We are a fully in\-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both as needed.

jobs.title: International Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.



At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.



A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're looking for an International Operations Manager to drive and manage the operational cadence supporting our international structure across local country teams. You will spearhead cross\-functional execution, lead end\-to\-end work item and resource planning, and operationalize group reporting, goal\-setting, and performance tracking. In this role, you'll build, own, and optimize the rhythms (such as QBRs, regular business reviews, and scorecards) that keep global workstreams aligned, resourced, and delivered on schedule.



This full\-time, hybrid (in\-office on Tues/Wed/Thurs) position is based in our San Mateo office and reports to the Head of International Strategy \& Ops.


### **You Will:**

* **Lead Cadence \& Operating Rhythms:** Spearhead and own internal operating cadences and reporting, including leading quarterly business reviews, establishing regular review rhythms with local international teams, and driving core alignment across regions.
* **Work Item \& Resource Planning:** Lead work item prioritization, project planning, and resource allocation across cross\-functional teams (Marketing, Comms, Trust \& Safety, Business Development, Finance, Legal) to ensure local market initiatives are properly scoped and supported.
* **Execution Management:** Oversee master project plans, timelines, and resource dependencies, actively driving follow\-ups and hold owners accountable to keep all global deliverables on track.
* Define and track core operational performance metrics and resource utilization, creating executive reporting for leadership.
* Gather inputs from country teams and XFN partners and synthesize into clear status updates, risks, and next steps.
* Lead recurring operational cadences (regional check\-ins, QBR prep, scorecards, resource allocation, and annual/quarterly planning cycles).
* Identify recurring operational gaps and implement process improvements
* Maintain and improve playbooks for repeatable workflows within local country teams across the world
* Serve as an operational point of contact between country teams and HQ partners for planning, execution, and issue triage.
* Coordinate with external vendors/agencies as needed
* Flag execution risks early (dependencies, resourcing, approvals, timelines) and help coordinate escalations to the right owners.
* Partner with Legal/Compliance/Trust \& Safety to ensure required steps are followed for market initiatives.

### **You Have:**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **6\+ years** of experience in operations, program management, business operations, or cross\-functional project coordination.
* Experience supporting international or multi\-region teams is a plus.
* Strong project management fundamentals (planning, tracking, risk management, stakeholder updates).
* Comfortable driving clarity across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize and simplify.
* Analytical and organized, with strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Familiarity with tooling such as spreadsheets, dashboards, and project trackers (e.g., Airtable, Asana/Jira) is a plus.


Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Title/Code:** Operations Manager

**Department**: Operations


**Reports To:** Vice President Operations


**Job Type:** Exempt **Location:** Concord, CA, 100% onsite




At EMCORE LLC, we're committed to attracting and nurturing diverse, high\-performing talent who are passionate about their work. Our employees share a common purpose\-supporting our customers' missions while pursuing their own professional growth. We foster an inclusive and engaging workplace culture where innovation, collaboration, and work\-life balance thrive. Core to our values is a steadfast commitment to excellence, community engagement, and integrity in everything we do.




**About EMCORE LLC**


EMCORE LLC is a leading independent provider of advanced inertial navigation solutions for the aerospace, defense, commercial, and industrial sectors. As pioneers in fiber optic gyros and Quartz MEMS technologies, we drive innovation across a wide range of navigation applications.

**Position Summary:**


The Operations Manager oversees and manages daily manufacturing operations within an aerospace production environment manufacturing quartz MEMS (QMEMS), ensuring products are built safely, efficiently, and to stringent quality standards. This role focuses on operational excellence, continuous improvement, resource planning, and leading cross\-functional teams to meet customer, regulatory, and organizational requirements and will be instrumental in driving yield improvement within a highly complex operating environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage daytoday production activities across assigned manufacturing areas and report daily through Business Unit Team meetings on shipments progress.
* Develop and manage staffing plans, shift schedules, labor allocation, and skills training.
* Ensure compliance with aerospace industry standards, regulations, and certifications (such as AS9100, ISO 9001\).
* Drive throughput, productivity, and cost improvements while maintaining quality and safety in alignment with Business Unit objectives.
* Implement and sustain productivity efforts, process optimization, and wastereduction initiatives in support of annual plan CapEx and productivity targets and timelines.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Program Management to support production readiness and resolve issues.
* Develop, implement, monitor, and adapt KPIs such as ontime delivery, scrap/rework, cycle time, customer satisfaction, safety metrics, and labor efficiency.
* In partnership with Quality, lead rootcause analysis and corrective actions for production challenges, quality escapes, or process deviations.
* Manage production equipment, tooling needs, preventive maintenance priorities, and facility support requirements.
* Support development, planning, and execution for new product introductions, process changes, and technology upgrades.
* Prepare operations reports and present performance updates to leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of supervision and or management experience in aerospace, defense, or complex precision electronics manufacturing.
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 aerospace or similar quality standards, production documentation, process controls, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate teams, manage priorities, and solve problems in a fastpaced production environment.
* Ability to manage and analyze data to support strategic operational decisions.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. (U.S. citizenship or Permanent Resident).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with ERP/MRP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.).
* Formal lean or Six Sigma certification.
* Experience with quartz\-based MEMS or inertial sensor products (gyroscopes and accelerometers).
* Experience with cleanroom environments (ISO Class 5\-8\).
* Background in highmix / lowvolume aerospace production environments.
* This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that an employee in this position may be asked to perform from time to time. EMCORE LLC reserves the right to revise or change job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

**Salary:**


The position offers a salary range of $140 \- $175K annually, depending on the candidate's experience, skill set, and overall qualifications.




* **As a federal contractor, we are required to have all candidates offered employment to pass a criminal background check prior to starting employment.**




**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

*Separate from employment eligibility (Form I\-9\), US export license requirements may apply before the Company can provide certain non\- "U.S. persons" with access to specific technology, software, and hardware that may be necessary for a position. As such, this position may require ITAR or EAR clearance, consistent with the U.S. citizenship or Permanent Resident requirement stated above.*

jobs.description:

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.


Your impact
At Jacobs, we are seeking to have a **Resilience Project Manager** based out of **San Francisco or San Jose, CA** join our California Water team. As a Resilience Project Manager, you will support planning, coordination, and delivery of resilience and climate adaptation projects in the region. Work with multidisciplinary teams to advance projects from early planning through design and construction, with a focus on complex urban waterfront and coastal resilience programs. Interface between planning and engineering to manage project delivery, coordinate technical disciplines, and translate flood risk science and engineering analysis into strategies that decision\-makers, communities, and partner agencies can act on. Beyond project delivery, you will support business development and contribute to building our resilience practice.

  

  

What You'll Do:


* Project Delivery: Manage delivery of resilience and flood risk projects across planning, design, and construction phases, including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and QA/QC. Oversee multidisciplinary project teams spanning engineering, environmental, and planning disciplines. Mentor and develop junior staff across technical and project management capabilities.
* Engineering Team Interface: Coordinate engineering teams through design development, review deliverables, and interpret hydraulic modeling, flood risk analysis, and coastal engineering outputs to inform project decisions and communicate findings to decision\-makers and public audiences.
* Interagency Coordination and Community Engagement: Lead coordination with public agency clients, city departments, and federal, state, and regional partners. Support community engagement and co\-design processes that center equity and ensure project outcomes reflect community priorities alongside technical and environmental performance.
* Resilience and Adaptation Strategy: Contribute to vulnerability assessments, flood risk analyses, and adaptation strategy development. Support development and evaluation of adaptation alternatives using frameworks that consider hazard reduction, equity, environmental performance, social value, cost, and implementation feasibility – across a range of adaptation project, program, and policy options.
* Communication and Public Presentation: Prepare briefings, decision memos, technical summaries, and presentations for senior leadership, elected officials, regulatory bodies, and public audiences. Deliver public presentations to community groups, stakeholder forums, and interagency audiences.
* Business Development and Practice Building: Support pursuit of new project opportunities through proposal development and client relationship building. Contribute to growing the resilience and adaptation practice through thought leadership and cross\-project collaboration.
  

  

\#LI\-AC2

* Bachelor's degree in Geography, Environmental Science, Urban Planning, Environmental Management, Public Policy, or related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in flood risk management, climate adaptation, coastal resilience, or related infrastructure and environmental program delivery.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary project teams to coordinate technical delivery, review engineering and design outputs, and maintain QA/QC standards.
* Experience working with public agency clients and coordinating across multiple government agencies and stakeholders in complex urban or infrastructure settings.
* Ability to communicate complex technical information to senior decision\-makers, elected officials, and public audiences, including delivering public presentations.

* Master's degree in Climate Science, Environmental Policy, Urban Planning, Water Resources, Coastal Management, or related field.

* Experience with spatial planning, urban design, and/or landscape approaches for integrating adaptation measures into multibenefit improvements.

**Why Harvey**
==============


At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.


This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.


Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.


At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


**Role Overview**
=================


Harvey ships fast, and our customers tell us constantly what's working and what isn't — through CSMs, support, sales, and early\-access programs. Today that signal lives in a hundred places and reaches Product inconsistently, and the systems that let the EPD organization plan, review, and fix things at scale are still being built. You will own those systems: a single Voice of the Customer program that turns scattered feedback into structured, trusted input for every product team; a bug management process that gets defects triaged, prioritized, and resolved predictably; and the operating rhythm that keeps Engineering, Product, and Design aligned. You own the infrastructure and cadence; embedded Product Operations Managers own the interpretation and day\-to\-day judgment for their product areas.


**What You'll Do**
==================


### **Voice of the Customer Program**


* Design and stand up the end\-to\-end feedback pipeline: intake from CS, Support, Sales, and EAPs into one structured system
* Partner with RevOps to design \& implement tooling; define the workflows that make submitting feedback the easy default for field teams
* Set the weekly triage cadence and SLAs so every piece of signal is classified, routed, and visible
* Build reporting that Product, GTM, and leadership actually read — volume, themes, trends, and what changed
* Own the classification model: product area, matter stage, root cause (missing capability, defect, or usability friction)
* Give Design and Research standing views into the signal that matters to them

### **Product Operating Rhythm**


* Design and run the core engineering, product \& design rituals: planning cycles, roadmap reviews, design reviews, and monthly business reviews
* Build the run\-of\-business systems that scale as Harvey grows — intake frameworks, RACI structures, decision logs, shared calendars
* Facilitate roadmap planning by coordinating inputs across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM and maintaining transparency across the org
* Make it clear across Harvey what EPD is building, how it's progressing, and what's coming next
* Own the end\-to\-end bug lifecycle: intake from Support and the field, severity definitions, triage, routing to engineering teams, and resolution tracking
* Define severity and SLA standards that CS, Support, and Engineering all agree to and can see
* Run the recurring bug review with engineering and product leads; escalate aging or customer\-impacting defects
* Report bug volume, aging, and resolution trends by product area, and connect defect signal back into the Voice of the Customer taxonomy
* Close the loop with Support and CS so customers hear when their issue is fixed

=================


* 5\+ years in program management, product operations, or a related operational role at a high\-growth tech or SaaS company
* You've built processes and programs from scratch and scaled them — not just inherited and maintained them
* Hands\-on experience running bug triage or incident/defect management processes across Engineering and Support
* Experience designing and facilitating product development rituals — planning, reviews, prioritization — with senior engineering and design leaders

* Proven ability to drive alignment and adoption across CS, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering without direct authority
* Experience with AI\-native or highly technical products is a plus
* You create clarity where none exists, and you're energized by a blank slate

jobs.title: Program Leader, GenAI & Voice AI Innovation
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  

  

The Program Leader, GenAI \& Voice AI Innovation sits within the Global Digital Experience (GDX) team \- the digital service design arm of the global CommOps organization. This role owns the end\-to\-end operationalization of transformational GenAI and Voice AI programs: scoping products for high business impact, running vendor pilots, designing evaluation frameworks, removing implementation roadblocks, and building the phased playbooks that take a program from a handful of pilot calls to a multi\-market, multi\-language rollout.
  

  

This is a builder's role. You'll typically run more than one program at a different stage of maturity at the same time \- a live vendor pilot needing daily quality monitoring, an expansion strategy needing market\-by\-market sequencing, and a cross\-functional standing forum needing weekly alignment \- and you'll be the person who can hold all three without dropping a thread.
  

  

The successful candidate combines strong technical and business acumen with the operational rigor to build repeatable frameworks (SOPs, evaluation rubrics, scale\-up gates) out of a first\-of\-its\-kind pilot, and the stakeholder management skill to bring Tech, Product, Ops, and external vendors along at the same time.
  

  

**What You'll Do**  

  

**Program \& vendor management**
* Own end\-to\-end program management for GenAI/Voice AI pilots \- from vendor selection and evaluation through phased global expansion \- managing multiple programs at different stages simultaneously.
* Design and run structured vendor evaluation frameworks (manual call/transcript review \+ quantitative metrics) to select, compare, and manage competing GenAI vendors running parallel pilots on separate traffic splits.
* Own the day\-to\-day pilot operations during launch windows, including hands\-on quality monitoring (e.g., reviewing live call/session volume) as a deliberate checkpoint before scaling traffic.
* Lead knowledge/API handoff and onboarding packages for external vendor partnerships.

**Product scoping \& policy design**
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering to translate existing operational policy (e.g., rigid if/then decision trees) into conversational, agentic flows with guardrails suitable for GenAI/LLM\-driven automation.
* Curate golden datasets with Product and Ops partners \- hand\-picking representative and edge\-case scenarios \- to ground evaluation and model tuning.
* Identify the right business problems and use cases to apply GenAI/Voice AI and quantify potential impact (e.g., cost savings, resolution rate, handle time, CSAT) to prioritize the roadmap.

**Evaluation frameworks \& quality governance**
* Author and maintain evaluation SOPs that define the standard for quality measurement across automated (on\-platform) and manual (offline human judgment) evaluation tracks, including critical vs. non\-critical error taxonomies.
* Run recurring QA review and calibration cadences; consolidate insights and KPIs into recommendations for Engineering and Product.
* Define and enforce phased scale\-up gates (data review, manual evaluation sign\-off, leadership sign\-off) before expanding a program's scope, market, or traffic allocation.

**Scaling \& cross\-functional leadership**
* Author multi\-phase expansion strategies spanning markets, languages, and policy types, including market/policy selection criteria, rollout sequencing, and pre\-launch requirements (legal/compliance, technical validation, evaluator readiness).
* Bring insights and feedback, socialize impact broadly, and hand over mature programs to BAU (Business As Usual) teams once scaled.
* Serve as the GDX point of contact / escalation owner for adjacent platform topics that intersect with your programs (e.g., AI safety/guardrail enablement decisions), clarifying ownership boundaries with partner platform teams.
* Represent your program portfolio in operating reviews, quarterly planning intake, and cross\-functional standing forums (tech program syncs, weekly business/vendor syncs, quarterly alignment forums).
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with Tech and Ops stakeholders to communicate program status, educate on new capabilities, and evangelize adoption of transformative technology.

**Basic Qualifications*** Minimum 5 years of experience in Product Management, Program Management, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or MBA.
8\+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, or a similar role, including direct ownership of vendor pilots or 0* 1 programs.
* Hands\-on experience designing evaluation frameworks/rubrics and quality SOPs for AI or automation programs (golden datasets, calibration sessions, critical\-error taxonomies).
* Experience with conversational AI / Voice AI / LLM\-agent products, including translating operational policy into agentic flows with guardrails.
* Experience managing global, multi\-market, multi\-language program rollouts with phased gating criteria.
* Familiarity with AI safety, guardrail, or trust \& safety considerations in production AI systems, and comfort acting as a cross\-team escalation point on ambiguous ownership questions.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and program management skills; ability to adapt to failed experiments and pivot quickly to new initiatives.
* Strong track record at a top\-tier strategy consulting or tech firm delivering implementation projects.
* Ability to read technical documentation (PRDs, architecture diagrams) and translate it for operational and business stakeholders.
* Exceptionally strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to push back constructively.
* Data\-driven mindset \- comfortable defining and reporting on metrics like resolution rate, CSAT, average handle time, and cost savings to justify scale decisions.
Obsession for delivering a great customer experience; strategic/visionary thinker.

Obsession for delivering a great customer experience; strategic/visionary thinker.

jobs.title: Physical Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Pivot Point Solutions**
=========================



Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based consulting firm that delivers experienced field professionals to construction and utility organizations across the state. We partner with contractors, program owners, and utility clients to provide skilled inspection, construction management, and field support personnel who keep infrastructure projects safe, compliant, and on schedule.



Our team understands the demands of active construction environments, from underground gas and electric infrastructure to large\-scale utility programs. By pairing deep industry knowledge with a responsive, hands\-on approach, we help clients maintain quality, meet regulatory requirements, and keep field operations running smoothly on some of California's most critical infrastructure projects.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Title:** Physical Security Project Manager  

**Sector:** Physical Security / Construction  

**Seniority:** Senior Level  

**Primary Locations:** Santa Cruz or Santa Clara, CA  

**Travel:** Occasional travel to Monterey and San Bernardino, CA  

**Job Type:** Hybrid – Office, Field \& Home  

**Contract Length:** 1 Year \+  

**Compensation:** $58\.00 \- $80\.00/hour


**Role Overview**
-----------------



Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced Physical Security Project Manager to lead the planning and field execution of complex physical security and low\-voltage system projects throughout California. This role will oversee projects involving access control, video surveillance/CCTV, intrusion detection, perimeter protection, intercoms, and supporting electrical and low\-voltage infrastructure.



The ideal candidate brings at least seven years of relevant project management experience and a strong field construction background. This position requires someone who can move comfortably between project planning and active job sites, coordinate contractors and technical teams, evaluate installation conditions, manage budgets and schedules, and oversee testing and commissioning while maintaining disciplined project documentation and governance.


**Your Day\-to\-Day Activities**
--------------------------------


* Manage physical security and low\-voltage projects from planning and site assessment through installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, resource requirements, milestones, and project documentation.
* Conduct job walks and site assessments to validate design requirements, installation conditions, constructability, and project risks.
* Coordinate installation of access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarms, intercoms, perimeter security, and supporting infrastructure.
* Manage security integrators, subcontractors, technicians, vendors, and other project resources.
* Coordinate physical security activities with IT, Corporate Security, facilities, construction teams, and business stakeholders.
* Review construction drawings, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, and installation requirements.
* Coordinate procurement of equipment, materials, permits, and other resources necessary for project execution.
* Monitor field activities for safety, workmanship, quality, schedule adherence, and compliance with project requirements.
* Troubleshoot technical and construction issues and coordinate solutions with installation teams and stakeholders.
* Oversee inspection, functional testing, commissioning, and turnover of installed security systems.
* Maintain accurate project records, including risk and issue logs, change documentation, as\-built information, progress reports, and closeout packages.
* Track project budgets, labor hours, material costs, forecasts, and overall financial performance.
* Identify scope changes and coordinate appropriate change management and change order documentation.
* Provide structured project status reporting to project sponsors, clients, and internal stakeholders.
* Proactively identify project risks, dependencies, and field constraints and drive mitigation plans through resolution.
* Coordinate final project handoff to operations and support teams.

**The Job Requirements**
------------------------


* 7\+ years of relevant experience managing physical security, low\-voltage, electrical, or closely related field construction projects.
* Direct experience managing field installation projects involving physical security systems.
* Strong knowledge of access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, alarms, perimeter protection, or related security technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise access control or video management platforms such as AMAG, Software House, Genetec, or comparable systems.
* Strong understanding of low\-voltage construction and installation practices.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, technical specifications, and related project documentation.
* Experience managing contractors, security integrators, technicians, vendors, and other field resources.
* Experience conducting site assessments, job walks, inspections, testing, and commissioning.
* Strong project management experience across scope, schedule, budget, risk, change, resources, and project documentation.
* Experience operating within structured PMO processes and maintaining project governance documentation.
* Strong communication, leadership, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel between project locations.
* Ability to work in active construction environments and wear required PPE, including FR clothing, hard hat, safety vest, and appropriate safety footwear.
* Ability to work a hybrid schedule across office, field, and home environments.
* Ability to support projects primarily in Santa Cruz and Santa Clara, with occasional travel to Monterey and San Bernardino.

**You'll Stand Out If You Have**
-------------------------

jobs.title: Student Assistant - Assistant Project Manager (Oakland, CA)
jobs.description:
Caltrans manages more than 50,000 miles of California’s highway and freeway lanes, provides inter\-city rail services, permits more than 400 public\-use airports and special\-use hospital heliports, and works with local agencies. Caltrans carries out its mission of providing a safe, sustainable, integrated and efficient transportation system to enhance California’s economy and livability, with six primary programs: Aeronautics, Highway Transportation, Mass Transportation, Transportation Planning, Administration and the Equipment Service Center.  



  

To learn more visit www.dot ca.gov .


  
The California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) is seeking to hire a student assistant, in a learning capacity, to work under the close supervision of a Project Manager in the Office of Program/Project Management. In a learning capacity, the student assistant will develop and track schedules, setup and monitor meetings, update databases among other duties as assigned. The student assistant will develop an understanding of how to work with other teams, use project management software, come up with a schedule, and identify risks to project deliveries.


  
**Conditions of Employment**

This is a part\-time, temporary, non\-benefited, student position. Employment in all positions with University Enterprises, Inc. is dependent upon the mutual consent of University Enterprises, Inc. and the employee. This means that either University Enterprises, Inc. or the employee can, at any time, terminate the employment relationship at will, with or without cause.  



Depending on the type of position you are applying for, a pre\-employment background check consisting of one or more of the following may be conducted: employment history, professional references, criminal check: educational verification (degree, license, or official transcript) or DMV clearance. Applicants will be required to pass required pre\-employment checks to the satisfaction of University Enterprises, Inc. (UEI) and the hiring Agency or Department.  



UEI does not allow students to hold more than one UEI Job at a time, or work in more than one account per pay period. UEI employees who are considering leaving their current UEI Student assistant position for a different UEI student assistant position should inform their supervisor in writing and provide at least a week’s notice.  



UEI is not a multi\-state employer. UEI only employs candidates who live and work in the state of California. If selected for the position you must reside in California and all work must be performed in the state of California throughout the course of employment.  



  

**Prerequisites**

Must be a college student attending classes during the regular term (Fall, Spring and Winter, if applicable), at one of the accredited colleges or universities on our affiliation list.
  

  

To view our current affiliation list please paste the following URL into your browser: http://www.calinterns.org/wp\-content/uploads/Affiliation\_List.pdf
  

  

Students must be enrolled in at least six\-semester units or nine quarter units for undergraduate students; four\-semester units or six quarter units for graduate students.
  

  

Students declared major must match the major(s) listed in the job posting.  



  

**Majors/Fields of Study**

Project and Program Management (PPM), Business Administration/Management, or closely related field.  



  

**Work Schedule**

F lexible workdays and work hours, Monday – Friday, between 8 AM – 5 PM. The final work schedule will be determined by the supervisor.  



  

**Additional Work Schedule**

Student Assistant and Graduate Assistant employees generally work up to 24 hours per workweek (Sunday – Saturday) during the academic year and up to 40 hours per workweek during breaks; (winter, spring, summer).  



  

**Compensation**

$18\.27 – $24\.62 per hour.  



  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Must maintain a minimum cumulative 2\.0 GPA.
Must complete each term with minimum unit requirements for Undergraduate and Graduate student classifications. Proof will be collected at the end of each Spring and Fall term.  
* 
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Under the amendment to Government Code Section 18220, state agencies shall give preference to a qualified applicant (up to 26 years of age) who is, or has been, a dependent child in foster care, a homeless youth, a formerly incarcerated youth, or a victim of human trafficking.  

* 
  

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* In a learning capacity, the Student Assistant will assist in tracking project resources, milestones, and ongoing progress.
* In a learning capacity, the Student Assistant will assist in developing and tracking project schedules in coordination with other units.
* In a learning capacity, the Student Assistant will assist as a point of contact for internal teams and facilitate meetings.
In a learning capacity, the Student Assistant will attend meetings and provide notes and meeting minutes and other assignments as necessary.  
* 
  

**Physical Requirements**

Sit for extended periods; frequently stand and walk; manual dexterity and hand\-eye coordination; corrected hearing and vision to normal range; verbal communication; use of office equipment including computer workstations, telephones, calculators, copiers, printers and scanners with or without a reasonable accommodation.  



  

**Working Conditions**

Work is performed in an office environment.  



  

**Application Instructions**

Please complete all fields of the employment application. Include your educational history in the “Educational Experience” section and any employment history in the “Employment Experience” section of our application.  



In addition to your resume, **please upload your most recent transcripts.**

**Apply by: 11/7/2026**

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Entry**
Must be able to achieve many objectives of this position. Requires some amount of timely supervision to ensure the proper tasks are being accomplished and that communication is adequate, timely, in the correct manner (i.e., verbal, written, email, etc.)  

**Experience**
Consistently achieves all the objectives of this position. This individual also provides mentoring and direct day\-to\-day supervision to level 1 positions.  

**Lead**
Highly experienced in the position. This individual has a deep understanding of the many systems installed and maintained within the division. May act as a lead to assist others on very complex project tasks. Also provides mentoring and direct supervision when required on projects.
**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**
====================================


* Provides input to sales and operations regarding the technical and business considerations for construction or direct owner projects. This input could be associated with areas such as estimating, value engineering, timing, special resource needs, or other aspects peculiar to specific projects.
* Ensures project is booked correctly and that all necessary forms are completed for both internal and external purposes.
* Ensures project documents, estimate, and project information is available to project team members to maximize NXL’s productivity on the project.
* Determines if customer expectations are similar to NXL’s and if these can be achieved based upon NXL’s estimate or contractual scope. Provides feedback on this as appropriate internally and externally.
* Identifies and resolves potential project issues.Accurately forecasts costs for each area of the project and track this over time to achieve budget and forecast goals.
* Invoices projects timely and is actively engaged in collections to minimize aging.
* Coordinates material orders and timing with Material Coordinator to maximize cash flow and material handling efficiency. Ensures all equipment is compatible and will function properly to achieve the required sequences.
* Coordinates with Subcontractors or internal installation team to achieve maximum value in installations.
* Completes the monthly WIP re\-forecast.
* Recommends technical solutions to sales and operations. Assist Sales team during estimating phase.
* Identifies change order opportunities and coordinates with sales to document, pursue, and book them.
* Provide support to Next Level and other contractors to solve building operating issues that go beyond the controls or special systems operation.
* Communicate with internal employees as required to ensure Next Level labor is accurate and timely and estimated productivity is achieved in all areas.
* Provide leadership and input to others as requested or required to assist in the accurate estimation, design, installation, start up, commissioning, and training for building systems.
* Communicate with external organizations as required such as consulting engineers, building owners, and other contractors to ensure accurate and timely engineering.
* Provide support for ongoing service engineering and support for existing building systems.
* Reviews all engineered submittals ensuring adherence to scope, budget, and customer expectations as well as location standards. As required, provide input on employee goals and progress to supervisors and managers.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Skills and Qualifications:**
==============================


* Minimum of high school diploma.
* Two\-year technical degree in Electronics related studies preferred. An undergraduate degree in Electrical, Construction Management, or other related studies is excellent.
* Other technical experience such as military, on the job training programs, etc. may meet this requirement as determined by local management.
* Experience and expertise including but not limited to:
* An understanding of basic computer operating systems.
* Some experience with BAS programming.
* A clear ability to work with electronic equipment such as volt meters, amp meters, oscilloscopes, etc.
* The ability to troubleshoot basic electric and electronic circuitry including reading and interpreting electrical and electronic diagrams.
* A working understanding of AC power circuitry including breakers, multi\-phase power, etc. (120VAC and greater)
* Clear and concise ability to communicate verbally and in writing.
* An ability to understand empathetically the issues and perceptions others have and to creatively and successfully work through these issues to achieve a successful outcome and customer and employee satisfaction.
* Level 2 and Senior Project Managers have a very deep understanding of the BAS that control buildings. They also understand the other systems involved in the mechanical and electrical portions of building controls.
* Level 2 and Senior Project Managers also have the experience to provide extensive integration support for a multitude of building systems.

**Essential Functions:**
========================


* Be able to lift and carry ladders, drawings, personal computers, material, etc.
* Be able to spend significant time standing and walking on construction sites.
* Be able to climb several flights of stairs or ladders throughout a typical day on a construction site.
* Maintain a satisfactory driving record which, per Next Level’s vehicle policy, allows the individual to drive a company vehicle.
* Be physically able to kneel, stoop and crawl.

**Company Provided Benefits:**
==============================


* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* HSA/FSA
* 401K w/ company match
* Paid Vacation/Sick/Holiday

jobs.description:
Posted Thursday, September 24, 2026 at 8:00 AM
**Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services**


At HH Global, we help the world's most recognized brands turn their growth ideas into measurable impact through responsible marketing activation. We are a global marketing activation partner that connects brands to their customers and delivers sustainable marketing activation at scale. With over 4,000 colleagues across more than 55 countries, you'll join a diverse, high\-performing community, empowered to deliver sustainable, innovative solutions for our clients.


**Purpose of the Job**


Our client offers a suite of devices and tools that are used daily by billions and trusted by over 6 million businesses. Our client’s Product Graphics team manages all on\-product artwork across their hardware portfolio—including brand identity, repairability, and regulatory compliance. They partner closely with Industrial Design, Product Safety \& Compliance, and Engineering to deliver seamless hardware experiences.


As a Product Graphics Program Manager, you will serve as the point of contact for end\-to\-end product graphics workflow, intake management, and project execution. You will bridge design and production to ensure visual quality, technical precision, and regulatory integrity across all physical product markings and labels. From receiving direction to driving strategy, you will establish operational rigor and cross\-functional alignment from concept through mass production. This role requires exceptional planning, adaptability, and the ability to balance multiple complex programs across global teams.


*This role is hybrid (3\+ days a week onsite), based in Mountain View, CA.*


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Program Governance \& Execution**
* + Own and partner with client teams for end\-to\-end program life cycles across hardware development gates.
	+ **Track and manage the Product Graphics Worklog from creation to archive, proactively identifying risks, mitigations, and schedule dependencies.**
	+ **Build and maintain single\-source\-of\-truth program documentation, including Program Decks, Graphics trackers, DRI matrices, and CMF Process Sketchbooks.**
	+ **Drive early technical readiness testing, such as laser mark feasibility and compliance alignment, ensuring timely reviews and client partner sign\-offs.**
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Communication**
* + Act as the central operational hub between our client’s Product Graphics Designers, Industrial Design (ID), CMF team, Hardware Engineering, Product Management, Compliance, and external manufacturing partners.
	+ Maintain an active in\-person presence to foster cross\-team client relationships, align stakeholder expectations, and drive consensus during critical build gates.
	+ Lead regular working sessions, track action items, and distribute clear, asynchronous program updates and status reports across global time zones.
	+ Represent the client team in critical meetings to track actions, milestones, and deliverables.
	+ Provide definitive resolution for program graphics decisions in the absence of cross\-functional alignment.
* **Process Strategy \& Operational Excellence**
* + Identify operational gaps in technical graphics workflows and build scalable, standardized frameworks to resolve bottlenecks.
	+ Drive quarterly task planning, backlog prioritization, and long\-term designer capacity and workload allocation.
	+ Manage physical sample requests, digital asset allocation, and procurement needs to support testing and client executive reviews.

**Knowledge, Skills \+ Experience**


Minimum Qualifications


* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or design\-related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience in hardware, product graphics, CMF, or consumer electronics
* Experience managing hardware development lifecycles and collaborating with manufacturing partners
  

Preferred Qualifications


* Proven track record of driving cross\-functional alignment across design, engineering, and compliance teams
* Deep technical understanding of manufacturing processes and capabilities, printing processes, and cosmetic finishing
* Strong organizational skills with proficiency in building clear decks, workflow trackers, and program frameworks
* Self\-starter capable of driving direction, resolving ambiguities, and influencing cross\-functional leadership without formal authority
* Ability to multitask, analyze opportunities, proactively solve problems and accomplish challenging objectives with minimal direction
* Effectively navigate and operate in a deadline\-driven, rapidly changing work environment
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality
* Possesses a love of efficiency, the desire to produce a high\-quality deliverable, and an ability to execute against multiple projects in a technical work environment with often uncertain circumstances
  

For New York and California applicants: The salary range for this position is $130,000 to $150,000 annually. Actual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors and are unique to each candidate, including skill set, experience, certifications and work location. This range may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.


The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus targets, benefits and/or other applicable incentives.


**You belong in our global community**


Belonging is at the heart of HH Global. We don’t just talk about inclusion; our teams recognize it as a fundamental part of our culture. Join the global leader in responsible marketing activation services and bring your authentic self to a team that values you for who you are.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**


HMC Architects is an employee\-owned design firm with a desire to make a difference in our communities. As a purpose\-driven firm based on values, our mission to “design for good” drives everything we do. And our ownership culture creates alignment and increased commitment to that mission, keeping us on track to being successful.


**What We Do**


Founded with the purpose of anticipating community needs, HMC aims to create designs that have a positive impact, now and into the future. We focus primarily on opportunities to have the most direct contribution to communities through healthcare, education, and civic spaces.


**Why Join HMC**


As an employee owned company you become an owner after one year—receiving company\-provided shares at no cost and building long\-term financial growth as the firm succeeds. We also give back through our volunteerism with our Designing Futures Foundation, which advances sustainable and regenerative design and supports the next generation of innovators. In addition to this, we also support our team through:


* **Culture**: We put people over profits, giving them the flexibility to manage their work and life. We believe in fairness, equality in opportunity, and rewarding those who perform.
* **Wellness**: company paid wellness courses, on\-site gyms (at select locations), access to financial advisors and discounts to wellness platforms, gyms and more.
* **Professional Development**: LinkedIn learning access, business development training, supportive mentorship, company\-paid ARE study materials, exam fees, and licensure completion bonuses.
* **Comprehensive Comp and Benefits**: Base\+Bonus\+Equity\+401k, including student loan repayments, wellness programs, full medical, dental, vision, time off and holidays above industry standard.

**Job Summary**


We are looking for an experienced **Senior Project Manager** with **Healthcare** project experience. In this position you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and administering a major project or projects through all phases of development. You will work with staff, give directions and resolve architectural problems. You will establish and maintain budgets, schedules, and monitor adherence of terms of contract expectations. You will have autonomy to engage with clients and authority to direct, control, and monitor all project activities. Successful candidates will have strong multi\-tasking skills and ability to oversee two to three project managers and multiple project teams.


The position is based in our **San Jose, CA** office and follows a hybrid schedule, with team members working in the office three days per week and remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Fridays are also designated as half days.


***For candidates located within the greater Bay Area,*** a remote work arrangement may be considered, with a requirement to be in the office at least one day per week (Thursdays) and as needed to support client or project needs.


**Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage multiple projects through all phases of work with strong communication, organization, and delegation skills

**Company Overview:** Gexpro Services is a world\-class Supply Chain Services outsource provider, specializing in developing and managing production inventory management programs. Our managed inventory programs are designed to support manufacturing OEM’s with their engineered production material specifications, fulfillment, and quality requirements.

**Program Manager Benefits:** Gexpro Services offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Competitive compensation plus annual bonus
* Flexible work schedule
* Medical, dental, vision, life insurance and pet insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Employee assistance program and Health wellness programs
* 401(k) immediately with a competitive match.
* Several paid holidays and paid time off that includes personal, sick and vacation time.

**Program Manager Description:** The ideal Program Manager role will preferably possess a bachelor’s degree and/or have a combination of supply chain knowledge and relevant experience in a customer\-facing role. A qualified candidate should possess the ability to lead customer business review presentations on a variety of topics which may include but not limited to, on time delivery, sales trends, obsolesces inventory, cost saving initiatives, fulfillment solution projects, scope expansion and any other projects. It addition, the Program manager must be able to perform the following tasks:

  

* Develop a strategic and targeted customer service approach to attain and exceed annual sales quota and commercial margin rate of assigned customer account worth at least $1M in annual sales.

* Manage discrete, ILM, VMI and/or consignment inventory program(s), assessing the risks and opportunities, while consistently improving the fulfillment process.
* Provides customer account management which may include, but is not limited to tactical supports such, order entry, order inquiry, product information, order status, pricing, inventory inquiries, customer fulfillment and transportation management to analyze and resolve customer needs.
* Provides strategic account management which include more complex support such as forecasting, monitoring negative transactions, overall profitability and completing all contractual obligations.
* Working independently and/or with cross\-functional team members to resolve complex escalations from customer such as resolve shortages, possible line down, quality issues.
	+ Such as the NCNR and/RAM process
* Guarantee parts are ordered timely to insure on\-time delivery.
* Drive process improvements within assigned customer base.
* Resolve escalated/complex customer inquiries concerning shipment problems, order changes, invoice variations, etc., using root\-cause analysis.
* May attend/lead quarterly business review with internal team members or external customer and suppliers to provide performance and inventory updates to assigned customer base.

* Review customer forecast and usage through data analysis to show current trends and predict future trends to prepare correct stocking levels with consideration to lead times.

 **Program Manager Requirements:** The Program Manager should preferably possess a bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in a customer\-facing role within the supply chain industry OR an equivalent combination of education and experience within the supply chain industry in program management/sales/service capacities owning program strategy and end to end delivery. The Program Manager should possess a combination of proven product and application knowledge, negotiation skills, interpersonal skills, effective communication skills, organization skills, and problem\-solving skills to drive decisions with influence presenting to senior executive.
