jobs.title: Interior Design Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
RH at its core is about taste, and we believe the idea of scaling taste is large and far reaching.

  

The RH brand attracts the best designers, artisans, manufacturers and talent in our industry, scaling and rendering their work more valuable across our integrated platform, enabling us to curate the most compelling collection of luxury home furnishings in the world. We are moving the brand beyond curating and selling products to conceptualizing and selling spaces by building an ecosystem of products, places, services and spaces that elevates and establishes the RH brand as a global thought leader, taste and place maker.

  

At RH we believe deeply that the "right" people are our greatest asset. We value people with high energy, who possess the ability to energize others. People who are smart, creative and have a point of view. People who see the answer in every problem, versus those who see the problem in every answer. People who are driven, determined and won't take "no" for an answer. We value team players, people who are more concerned with what's right, rather than who's right.


Project Coordinators own key phases of the Interior Design Project lifecycle and contribute to the success of RH Interior Design by supporting our Lead Designers. This role is ideal for innovators with an entrepreneurial spirit and passion for establishing and fostering relationships.

  

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


* Live Our Vision, Values and Beliefs every day
* Provide a luxury experience for RH Interior Design clientele
* Create and maintain comprehensive project and design documentation
* Coordinate initial phases of interior design projects, including consultations and site visits in partnership with RH Interior Designers
* Serve as primary client liaison after design project completion, from order placement to delivery and installation
* Communicate and work with cross\-functional teams at all levels of the organization
* Ensure project schedules and timelines are met
* Represent the RH lifestyle brand through communication, personal appearance and professionalism
* Maintain a strong interest in the luxury and design industry
* Support the visual and Quality standards within the Gallery

OUR REQUIREMENTS


* Experience within a design firm, high\-end furniture showroom or luxury retail preferred
* Proven success coordinating concurrent projects
* Strategic with a relationship\-driven mentality
* Highly organized, collaborative and results\-oriented
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proficiency with Mac Operating System, IOS devices, Microsoft Office and Google Applications
* Solid technical background with experience using Salesforce or other customer relationship management systems

OUR PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS


* Ability to lift and mobilize small to medium items up to 25 lbs. while utilizing appropriate equipment and techniques
* Ability to maneuver effectively around Gallery floor, stock room and office
* Position entails prolonged standing, twisting, stooping, kneeling, squatting, bending and climbing
* Licensed to drive preferred
* Ability to travel locally or out of state

RH is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, marital status, age, disability, sexual orientation, military/veteran status, or any other status protected by federal or state law or local ordinance.  

  

At RH, we are committed to promoting pay equity. Rate of pay is determined based on each individual's experience, qualifications, and the geographic location of the role.

jobs.title: Training Program Coordinator, Commercial Education & Effectiveness
jobs.description:
Are you motivated to participate in a dynamic, multi\-tasking environment? Do you want to join a company that invests in its employees? Are you seeking a position where you can use your skills while continuing to be challenged and learn? Then we encourage you to dive deeper into this opportunity.


We believe in career development and empowering our employees. Not only do we provide career coaches internally, but we offer many training opportunities to expand your knowledge base! We have highly competitive benefits with a variety HMO and PPO options. We have company 401k match along with an Employee Stock Purchase Program. We have tuition reimbursement, leadership development, and even start employees off with 16 days of paid time off plus holidays. We offer wellness courses and have highly engaged employee resource groups. Come join the Neo team and be part of our amazing World Class Culture!

**NeoGenomics has an opening for a Senior Training Program Specialist, Commercial Education \& Effectiveness who wants to continue to learn in order to allow our company to grow. The ideal candidate will be located Remote Non\-CA with travel to Fort Myers for a week every other month.**

**Now that you know what we're looking for in talent, let us tell you why you'd want to work at NeoGenomics:**


As an employer, we promise to provide you with a purpose driven mission in which you have the opportunity to save lives by improving patient care through the exceptional work you perform. Together, we will become the world's leading cancer reference laboratory.

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Senior Training Program Specialist owns the operational backbone of the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness (CEE) training calendar. The role plans and runs the logistics for approximately five new hire training classes per year, each built as a virtual week followed by a week\-long in\-person program, and partners with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session. The Specialist schedules and confirms presenters, manages hotel and program logistics, prepares materials, administers the learning platform and the CEE SharePoint site, and maintains attendance, completion, and evaluation records.


This is a program and project management role. The Specialist is the single point of accountability for ensuring programs run on time, on budget, and without disruption to learning.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end logistics plan and timeline for approximately five new hire training classes per year, working backward from each class start date across both the virtual and in\-person portions of the program.
* Schedule and confirm presenters for virtual training sessions, including invitations, calendar management, content collection, quality review, and same\-day support.
* Manage hotel, venue, and participant travel logistics for week\-long in\-person programs, including room blocks, meeting space, audiovisual requirements, food and beverage coordination, and accessibility needs.
* Partner with the corporate event planning team on the Global Commercial Meeting (GCM) and Summer Session, owning the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness training workstream.
* Serve as the onsite point of contact during training programs, managing materials, shipping, badges, signage, room setup, and agenda changes.
* Track and reconcile program spend against budget, including vendor contracts, hotel invoices, purchase orders, and cost summaries.
* Build and maintain the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness SharePoint site, including document libraries, permissions, metadata, version control, and naming conventions.
* Audit and retire sales training content on a scheduled basis and coordinate required internal reviews for clinical, marketing, and claims\-related materials.
* Administer the learning platform, including curricula, enrollments, assignment rules, reporting, and learner record migration activities.
* Maintain accurate attendance, completion, assessment, and evaluation records and create post\-program reports.
* Utilize Microsoft Office and other digital tools to organize, track, and report training activities.
* Coordinate and facilitate communication within the commercial organization regarding training events, schedules, and updates.
* Support onboarding for new sales and support team members by ensuring system access and training resources are available before day one.
* Administer post\-training surveys and 60\- and 90\-day follow\-up assessments and summarize findings.
* Prepare manager touchpoint materials, including pre\-class briefing packets and post\-class coaching guides.
* Provide administrative support to the Commercial Education \& Effectiveness team and perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience, Education and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Five or more years of experience in program or project coordination, corporate meeting and event planning, training coordination, or a sales or support role.
* Experience in a diagnostic laboratory, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare environment preferred.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a cross\-functional environment.
* Experience coordinating multi\-day, multi\-presenter meetings or training programs, including registrations, room blocks, banquet event orders, and vendor invoicing.
* Strong professional verbal and written communication skills and a customer\-focused approach.
* Demonstrated SharePoint proficiency, including document libraries, permissions, metadata management, and version control.
* Ability to effectively follow up with senior leaders and subject matter experts to secure commitments, presentations, and approvals on schedule.
* Learning management system administration experience preferred.

jobs.title: Continuing Education Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Continuing Education Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting the administration, development, growth, and promotion of the organization’s continuing education programs. This position combines program coordination with business development, instructor recruitment, course development support, customer service, and marketing.

A significant focus of this position will be helping grow the continuing education program by identifying and recruiting qualified physicians, psychologists, and other professionals to develop and present courses, assisting with the development and launch of new educational offerings, and increasing awareness and enrollment through social media and other promotional channels.

The Continuing Education Program Coordinator will work closely with the supervisor to ensure courses and programs are well organized, professionally presented, and administered in accordance with applicable continuing education requirements.

Essential Duties and ResponsibilitiesContinuing Education Program Administration

* Assist with the day\-to\-day administration of the continuing education website and programs.
* Respond to participant questions regarding courses, registration, certificates, course access, and other administrative matters.
* Follow up with participants, instructors, and prospective instructors as needed.
* Monitor course registrations, completion requirements, evaluations, and other administrative components of continuing education programs.
* Assist with maintaining accurate course information, instructor information, schedules, and educational materials on the website.
* Identify administrative or participant issues and coordinate appropriate follow\-up and resolution.
* Help ensure continuing education documentation and records are maintained according to organizational and applicable regulatory requirements.

Program Growth \& Instructor Recruitment

A major responsibility of this position is assisting with the continued growth of the continuing education program.

* Identify and recruit physicians, psychologists, and other qualified professionals who may be interested in developing or presenting continuing education courses.
* Conduct outreach to prospective instructors and presenters through email, professional networks, associations, social media, and other appropriate sources.
* Follow up with prospective instructors and help guide them through the course development and onboarding process.
* Develop and maintain relationships with existing instructors to encourage additional course development.
* Research potential course topics, presenters, professional trends, and areas of educational demand.
* Identify opportunities to expand the organization's course offerings and audience.
* Track recruitment and course\-development efforts and provide regular updates to the supervisor.

Course Development

* Assist with the development of new continuing education courses under the direction and guidance of the supervisor.
* Coordinate with instructors to obtain course materials, biographies, disclosures, learning objectives, examinations or assessments, references, and other required information.
* Assist instructors with understanding course\-development requirements and timelines.
* Review submitted materials for completeness and coordinate revisions or additional information as directed by the supervisor.
* Assist with organizing and preparing course content for publication on the continuing education platform.
* Help coordinate the process from initial course concept through final publication and promotion.

Tele\-Course \& Live Program Coordination

* Assist with the planning and administration of live and teleconference continuing education programs.
* Coordinate schedules with instructors and presenters.
* Communicate program instructions and requirements to presenters and participants.
* Assist with registration, attendance tracking, participant communications, evaluations, and certificates.
* Help manage the online or teleconference platform before and during scheduled programs.
* Conduct follow\-up after programs to address participant questions and complete required administrative documentation.

Marketing \& Social Media

* Assist with promoting continuing education programs through Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, email, professional organizations, and other appropriate channels.
* Create or coordinate promotional posts for new courses, upcoming tele\-courses, instructors, and other educational offerings.
* Help maintain a consistent schedule of social media and promotional activity.
* Identify additional opportunities to reach physicians, psychologists, mental health professionals, and other target audiences.
* Assist with email campaigns and other outreach efforts designed to increase course enrollment.
* Monitor the effectiveness of promotional efforts and help identify strategies for increasing engagement and enrollment.

General Responsibilities

* Maintain professional communication with participants, instructors, prospective instructors, and outside organizations.
* Maintain organized records of instructor contacts, prospective courses, course\-development status, and follow\-up activities.
* Meet established deadlines and proactively follow up on outstanding items.
* Participate in meetings regarding program development, marketing, and growth.
* Provide regular updates regarding instructor recruitment, courses in development, upcoming programs, and promotional activities.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating professionally with physicians, psychologists, and other healthcare professionals.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable learning and managing website\-based administrative systems.

**Salary Range: $87,600 \- 117,100**

**Department: IT**

**Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high quality services and support, when, where and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state\-of\-the\-art technology\-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone.**

  

**Position Overview:**

  

The 988 Technical Support Supervisor is one of three key leaders responsible for overseeing part of the daily operations of the 24/7 support team, ensuring high\-quality technical support is delivered to end\-users. This role combines hands on troubleshooting expertise with leadership responsibilities, including team mentoring, workload management, and performance monitoring. The technical support supervisor plays a key role in maintaining service standards, improving support workflow, and serving as a liaison between the help desk, other IT teams, and leadership. This position requires strong communication, a customer\-first mindset, and the ability to lead by example in a fast\-paced environment.

  

  

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Monitor ticket queues and ensure timely responses, resolutions and SLA adherence.
* Assist with escalations, ensuring a smooth and professional resolution process.
* Identify training needs and help develop growth paths for team members.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams on bugs, feature clarifications, and improvements.
* Analyze support metrics and recommend process improvements. Regularly report team performance, escalations, and support trends to the manager.
* Maintain and improve internal knowledge base and workflow documentation.
* Assist with scheduling to ensure 24/7 coverage needs are met.
* Additional duties as assigned.
  

  

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Team Management: Proven experience supervising help desk or IT support staff in a high\-volume environment.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Strong knowledge of common IT systems, hardware, software, networking and remote support tools.
* Incident \& Escalation Management: Ability to assess and escalate issues appropriately while ensuring timely resolution.
* Customer Service Excellence: Demonstrated commitment to delivering user\-focused support with empathy and professionalism.
* Ticket System Proficiency: Familiarity with platforms such as Salesforce, Jira, and ServiceNow.
* Documentation: Ability to maintain knowledge base articles and ensure team adherence to standard operating procedures.
* Performance Monitoring: Monitor and track team metrics for continuous improvement opportunities.
* Customer Service Excellence: Demonstrated commitment to delivering user\-focused support with empathy and professionalism.
  

  

Decision Making:


* Prioritize incoming tickets based on urgency, impact, and alignment with SLAs to ensure timely resolution.
* Determine when to escalate issues.
* Make staffing decisions to handle ticket volume and shift coverage.
* Identify when updates to knowledge base documentations are needed.
* Make informed recommendations to management regarding process improvements.
* Work with the team and management to determine temporary workarounds as needed.
  

  

Scope of Responsibility/Accountability:


* Manages programs/projects, creates and implements work plans and objectives.
* Monitors and evaluates interim results and develops contingency plans if objectives are off track.
* Performance is reviewed by director level and above.
  

  

Managing/Directing Work:


* Assign and prioritize daily tasks, incidents, and service requests across the shift.
* Monitor workload distribution to ensure even coverage and timely resolution of tickets.
* Set clear performance expectations with team.
* Ensure tickets meet SLAs.
* Conduct regular check\-ins or huddles to provide updates.
* Coordinate shift transitions with the other supervisors.
* Identify and report to the manager on inefficiencies and how the team can improve.
  

  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or 4\+ years of technical support experience in lieu of degree.
* 3\+ years of experience in a technical support role.
* 2\+ years of experience in a team lead, supervisory, or people management role
* Experience supporting 24/7 or shift\-based technical support environments preferred
* Technical certifications a plus, including: CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Security\+, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, Microsoft Technology Associate (MTA)
  

  

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position for at least 50% of the time
* Will constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer
* Will frequently communicate over video calls and other channels with internal and external stakeholders

jobs.title: Program Manager - Hub Operations
jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real\-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

  

The Program Manager will serve as the primary client contact for pharmaceutical program(s). This includes managing the day\-to\-day activity of the program and supervising the assigned program staff. To succeed, this person will maintain extensive interaction with internal and external customers, help define and execute the work plan for program staff, have significant participation in programs’ strategic planning, and be accountable for the proper execution of contract terms for assigned program(s). The Market Access Program Manager reports to the Market Access Program Director within Valeris’ HUB Services organization.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage program(s) per the scope of work, program and standard operating procedures within the contracted budget
* Manage the client relationship, gaining trust and building rapport
* Manage day\-to\-day activity of program operations, including supervision of staff
* Directly or through supervisors, drive assigned performance responsibilities of team and team members
* Monitor and report on program statistics and metrics used to measure the performance of team members, teams, and the overall program
* Escalate issues that put the program(s) in jeopardy of not delivering to contracted standards
* Strong ability to prioritize and manage personal schedule as well as the schedules of others
* Work cross\-functionally with internal stakeholders for program operational responsibilities
* Contribute to the analysis and writing of client reports and other deliverables
* Present program data, information, and insight to internal and external customers on a regular basis
* Participate with Hub Services leadership and client team on initiatives to improve process and performance
* Mobilize internal and external stakeholders with respect to program design, program improvements and/or changes
* Travel on a limited basis to and attend related meetings/conferences as required
* Participate in interviewing prospective employees, evaluating current employees, and training employees
* Provide verbal and written feedback to team members based on performance reviews, statistics, QA results, and observed behaviors
* On time adherence to training deadlines for all corporate policies and procedures governing access to confidential data
* Ensure all SOPs are followed with consistency
* May assist with requirements identification, specifications development and User Acceptance Testing to support program and other responsibilities as needed
* Utilize Valeris’ values as the driving force behind the team’s success
* Perform additional tasks or projects as assigned

 **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent work experience
* 4\-6 years of experience working in Reimbursement, Pharmaceutical Marketing or Patient Services
* Experience managing a team of Case Managers, Patient Service Representatives, or similar role
* Experience reporting on HUB metrics and communicating trends to clients
* Demonstrated successful leadership experience
* Excellent PC skills including Microsoft Office and Internet experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong technical aptitude and experience working in various CRM software platforms

**Physical Demands \& Work Environment**
========================================

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit for long periods of time, use hands to type, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Prefer candidates who can type at least 35 words per minute with 97% accuracy.
* Although very minimal, flexibility to travel as needed is preferred.
* This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, etc.

=========================


We’re committed to supporting the well\-being and success of our team members. As part of our organization, full\-time employees can expect:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans, including HSA\- and FSA\-eligible options, with Valeris contributing toward premium costs
* Additional health support, including telehealth and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
* Company match on Health Savings Account contributions
* Free Basic Life and AD\&D coverage equal to your annual earnings, with a minimum of $50,000 and a maximum of $300,000
* Company\-paid Short\-Term Disability coverage, with the option to purchase Long\-Term Disability
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% match on the first 5% you contribute, with immediate vesting
* Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave to support work\-life balance

jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.
  
The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.
  
  

**Location:** Preferred Northeast or Southeast
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to Media and Entertainment’s consulting projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, internal and external consultants and subject matter experts, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members. Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Coordinates all deliverable documentation between all internal and external stakeholders. Facilitates and directs document reviews to assure proper documentation is delivered to the client. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates transition of projects to later phase project teams.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence, and people management skills. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.


**Physical Demands:**  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee. The employee will experience normal office conditions and be required to use office equipment such as computers, peripherals, etc.
  
  

**Travel:**  

Some travel by car and occasional airplane trips should be expected as much of our consulting work is conducted remotely with occasional in person meetings. Employee must possess a valid driver’s license in their state of residence. Employee will be required to use their own vehicle and will be reimbursed for mileage at the current corporate rate. 10% remote travel is not unusual.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------


The BioWatch Project Manager (PM) oversees nationwide BioWatch laboratory staffing and operational support for the Department of Homeland Security’s Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction Office. This position serves as the contractor’s primary point of contact for DHS, ensuring high\-quality laboratory performance, staffing continuity, compliance with federal standards, and successful execution of mission\-critical biothreat detection operations. The PM leads distributed scientific teams and ensures BioWatch laboratories maintain 24/7 readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead and manage all contractor activities supporting BioWatch laboratory operations across multiple jurisdictions.
* Serve as the single point of contact for the DHS Contracting Officer and Contracting Officer’s Representative.
* Oversee daily performance, attendance, conduct, and quality compliance for all contractor lab personnel.
* Ensure staffing levels meet or exceed DHS requirements and coordinate timely recruitment, replacement, and onboarding.
* Support adherence to BioWatch standard operating procedures, quality assurance programs, and national security protocols.
* Coordinate with Technical Managers and Training Manager to resolve operational issues, implement corrective actions, and maintain training compliance.
* Provide monthly progress reports, annual performance updates, and regular briefings to DHS leadership.
* Ensure readiness for surge support, special events, and emergency deployments, including rapid mobilization of trained staff.
* Maintain professional communication with state and local Laboratory Directors, ensuring seamless partnership and operational continuity.

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, molecular biology, or a closely related biological science.
* At least **six years of laboratory bench experience** with PCR and biological laboratory techniques.
* Minimum **three years of experience** as a Senior Scientist, Project Team Lead, or Laboratory Supervisor.
* Strong leadership skills managing dispersed scientific teams and complex operations.
* Ability to communicate effectively with federal, state, and local partners.
* PMP certification **highly encouraged**.
* Ability to respond to DHS inquiries within two hours during business hours (0800–1800 ET).
* Eligibility to pass DHS background checks and meet security requirements.

  

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* Primarily remote with required travel to laboratory sites and DHS headquarters in Washington, DC.
* Supports a national program operating 24/7/365; occasional extended hours, weekends, and holiday work may be required.
* Participation in special events, surge operations, and emergency response deployments as needed.

 **Location:** Remote with travel to DHS and state/local public health laboratories  

  

**Clearance:** Ability to obtain DHS Public Trust background clearance

jobs.title: Network Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  

Effortless Office partners with our customers to make IT effortless so they can focus on their business. As a Hybrid Managed Services Provider (MSP) with a focus on providing world\-class customer experience, we deliver and fully support secure cloud solutions as well as comprehensive managed IT and network services.

**About the Role:**


Effortless is looking for a Network Operations Manager who is an excellent leader and engineer. This is a player\-coach role: you will lead our network engineering team while remaining one of the company's top escalation and design resources for enterprise, high\-availability, multi\-platform networks.


You will own the health, security, and continuous improvement of the networks we manage for our customers and within our own Switch data center infrastructure. We expect you to be proactive: you will not wait for tickets. You and your team will regularly review client environments, find risk, capacity, and performance gaps before they become outages, and bring clear, cost\-effective recommendations to our customers and Service Delivery Teams.


The ideal candidate has served as a Senior Network Engineer, has the technical depth to earn the respect of senior engineers, and has the leadership skills to develop them. You set a high standard, communicate clearly, take ownership, and care about the customer experience.

**Position Details:**

**Reports to:** President

**Direct reports:** Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers

**Location:** Remote with a preference for someone in/near Las Vegas, NV.

**Travel:** Some travel required for data center work, client site visits, and special projects.

**Schedule:** Monday \- Friday 8:00\-5:00 PST, with 24/7 escalation availability for major incidents and management of the team's on\-call rotation.

**Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401K \+ employer match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* Training and certification support

### **Engineering Excellence**

* Serves as the company's senior network engineering authority and final escalation point in core routing and switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Designs, reviews, and approves complex network configurations and architecture, including hardware and software technology, site locations, business continuity, disaster recovery, and integration of technologies.
* Personally assesses and resolves the most complex data network problems and incidents, and leads major incident response through to resolution and root cause analysis.
* Owns the design, standards, and lifecycle of Effortless's own network infrastructure at our Switch data centers, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SDWAN (Meraki and Cisco Viptela) environments.
* Sets and maintains network engineering standards, configuration baselines, and documentation requirements in IT Glue, and reviews the team's work for quality and consistency.
* Reviews analyses and technical feasibility to develop data network deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates.

### **Proactive Client Improvement**

* Leads a regular program of proactive network reviews across client environments to find security, reliability, capacity, and performance gaps before they cause issues.
* Uses Auvik monitoring, ticket trends in Autotask, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and drive permanent fixes rather than repeated reactive work.
* Assesses data network growth forecasts and ensures business needs are translated into network capacity requirements.
* Partners with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and ESAs to turn findings into clear, cost\-effective recommendations for each client's technology roadmap.
* Tracks hardware and firmware end\-of\-life, vulnerabilities, and configuration drift across managed networks and plans remediation.
* Brings the customer's perspective to every recommendation: leads with business outcomes, not technology features.

### **Leadership**

* Hires, onboards, coaches, and develops Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers, including technical mentoring and certification planning.
* Sets clear expectations, holds regular 1\-on\-1s, conducts performance reviews, and holds the team accountable using EOS tools (Rocks, Scorecards, Issues, To\-Dos) in Strety.
* Manages team workload, project priorities, and resource availability, and plans and coordinates cross\-functional or cross\-company work.
* Owns network change management: reviews and approves changes, maintenance windows, and rollback plans.
* Manages the team's 24/7 on\-call rotation and escalation process, and ensures after\-hours coverage meets Effortless's service standards.
* Communicates status, risk, and outcomes clearly to leadership, Service Delivery Teams, and customers, following our CWC (Communicate, Work, Communicate) value.

### **Operations and Compliance**

* Defines, tracks, and reports on network operations KPIs (see Success Measures below).
* Manages relationships with network vendors and carriers, including escalations, and supports procurement and licensing decisions.
* Ensures all compliance aspects of the position and team are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes, and regulations applicable to the position and company, including client HIPAA, PCI, and NIST requirements.
* Maintains sensitive and confidential information regarding company and customer information.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

### **Education and Work Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, or a related technical field
* 10\+ years of experience with Service Provider, MSP, or enterprise networking or general telecommunications
* 3\+ years in a Senior Network Engineer (or equivalent) role, serving as the top escalation and design resource for complex netw

jobs.title: Creative Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.


At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.


This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------



Leads the systems, governance, planning, and insights that enable the creative organization to operate effectively at scale. Owns intake, prioritization, capacity and resource planning, workflow governance, reporting, process design, and operational health. Partners with creative leadership to align resources with business priorities, improve how work moves through the organization, and build scalable practices that increase speed, visibility, accountability, and creative impact. Transforms reactive request management into a transparent, strategic, and scalable operating model.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* Own enterprise creative intake and set briefing, categorization, prioritization, and readiness standards so requests arrive with sufficient context, scope, and strategic clarity.
* Define pathways for planned, reactive, executive, innovation, and special\-initiative work; assess readiness, close information gaps, and improve submission quality before scoping or assignment.
* Maintain visibility into capacity, workload, utilization, project mix, skill demand, and constraints across internal teams and external partners; forecast needs using pipeline, priorities, seasonality, campaign calendars, and enterprise initiatives.
* Identify staffing gaps, bottlenecks, and over\-allocation risks before delivery is affected, informing staffing, contractor, agency, and headcount decisions.
* Evaluate demand with creative leadership based on strategic value, effort, priorities, and capacity, while providing portfolio visibility across current and upcoming work.
* Facilitate tradeoffs across campaigns, executive and reactive requests, brand initiatives, and capability\-building work; guide decisions to start, pause, accelerate, outsource, or decline work and align resources to highest\-impact priorities.
* Own the operating model from intake and scoping through assignment, production, review, approval, delivery, and measurement; define stages, roles, decision rights, handoffs, review cycles, escalation paths, and governance standards.
* Drive consistent use of work\-management tools, intake systems, dashboards, and processes while clarifying requirements and reducing friction across creative teams, stakeholders, agencies, PMO, and partner functions.
* Build dashboards and reporting on demand, project mix, throughput, cycle time, workload, utilization, velocity, and bottlenecks, giving leaders clear visibility into capacity, operating health, and tradeoffs.
* Track trends and define KPIs linking operations to creative effectiveness and business impact, using insights to guide staffing, partner strategy, prioritization, process improvement, speed, quality, clarity, and scale.
* Design, document, and improve workflows, SOPs, governance, briefs, review practices, and operating cadences; remove redundant work, unclear ownership, unnecessary approvals, and process gaps.
* Lead improvements that increase velocity, reduce rework, and strengthen stakeholder experience; communicate changes, drive adoption, and establish scalable practices for planned and reactive work.
* Configure tools to support the operating model and provide team and leadership visibility; identify opportunities for automation, templates, improved reporting, and workflow simplification.
* Partner with technology and operations teams to improve adoption, data quality, and system effectiveness, and set standards for tracking work, resources, timelines, and project metadata.
* Advise creative leadership on structure, resource planning, workload forecasts, agency and contractor strategy, future operating models, business cases, staffing recommendations, and capability planning.
* Identify recurring demand patterns requiring new roles, process or scope changes, or alternative partner models, and clarify how organizational design choices affect capacity, velocity, quality, and business impact.
**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------


* 7\+ years in creative or marketing operations, PMO, resource management, agency operations, or related operational leadership.
* Experience building and scaling processes in creative, marketing, brand, or content organizations.
* Strong knowledge of creative workflows, intake, resource and portfolio planning, and delivery governance.
* Experience with dashboards, KPIs, reporting, capacity models, and workflow or collaboration tools.
* Strong analytical, systems\-thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams and operate in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments with competing priorities.
* Experience advising senior leaders on prioritization, resourcing, and operating\-model decisions.

----------------

**About Slater Certified®**

Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. It delivers self\-paced training that prepares professionals for licensure and continuing education, built around G.A.I.L. (Generative Artificial Intelligence Learning) \- an interactive tutor that gives real\-time feedback, personalized explanations and adaptive support, so someone studying on demand still gets guidance. The flagship course is a 40\-hour Wastewater Class 3 Operator Training recognized by the Georgia Secretary of State, alongside a 24\-hour continuing education course and an industrial wastewater program. Organizations can run a customized version, Powered by Slater Certified®, against their own workforce.


Slater Certified, LLC is the workforce development arm of Slater Infrastructure Group, LLC \- an Alpharetta, Georgia infrastructure services firm founded in 1997, working across operations and maintenance, construction engineering and inspection, and environmental services for public and private clients. Slater Certified launched in July 2025 and is licensed in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia and Mississippi.


The team is small and moves fast. Technology choices are modern and made by the people who have to live with them, so the distance between an idea and a decision is short, and the distance between a decision and shipping it is shorter. Work is remote and the schedule is flexible. Ownership sits with the person doing the work, and there is real room to shape how things get built rather than inheriting someone else's process.


**Position summary**

Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. We are selling and building at the same time, with a small team and a lot of moving parts: prospects in conversation, clients being onboarded, courses in development, and commitments made in a sales meeting that engineering then has to deliver.


We are hiring a Project Manager on a contract basis to be the bridge between sales and delivery. You hold the single picture of where everything stands \- who is in the pipeline, who is in flight and how far along they are, what we can sell today, what is coming and when, and what each of those depends on. When sales asks whether we can commit to a date, you are the person who knows.


You will work directly with the VP of Sales, the CTBO and the engineering team, keeping logistics and pipeline moving. It is part project manager, part coordinator, part meeting facilitator \- hands\-on, no direct reports, and a lot of detail that nobody else is going to pick up. If it works on both sides, there is a path to converting it to a full\-time position.


**What this role owns in the first six months**

* One view of the pipeline and delivery that sales, engineering and leadership all use and all trust \- not three spreadsheets that disagree.
* The existing pipeline, built up so far by our business development lead, has been taken over and turned into something that runs as a system rather than living in one person's head.
* Every client in flight has a plan, a timeline, a named status and a next action, current enough that nobody has to ask.
* A standing, accurate answer to “what can we sell today, what is coming, and when” \- so sales stops guessing and engineering stops being surprised.
* Status reporting that leadership reads instead of requesting.
* Meetings that end with decisions and owners rather than another meeting.

**Key responsibilities**

**Bridging sales and delivery**


* Sit between the VP of Sales, the CTBO and engineering, and keep all three working from the same picture.
* Translate what sales is promising into what engineering has to build, and flag the gap before a commitment is made rather than after.
* Maintain what is sellable today versus what is on the roadmap, and keep that honest.
* Chase the dependencies between the two sides \- the content, the configuration, the approval, the answer from a customer \- so nothing stalls quietly.

**Pipeline and clients in flight**


* Take handover of the pipeline as it stands today from business development, and make it current, complete and usable by everyone who needs it.
* Track prospects through the pipeline: where each one stands, what it is waiting on, what it would take to close.
* Run onboarding for clients in flight end to end, from kickoff to go\-live.
* Keep the CRM and the delivery plan reflecting the same reality.
* Be the point of contact who knows the status, and who tells a client before they have to ask.

**Delivery with engineering**


* Own the Jira board: hygiene, flow, and whether it still describes how work actually moves.
* Turn requirements into tickets with clear scope and acceptance criteria, and push back when a requirement is not ready.
* Run the cadence \- planning, standups, retrospectives \- at whatever weight a small team can sustain without ceremony for its own sake.
* Track work through the release path into TEST and on to production, and make sure nothing sits in a column because nobody noticed.

documentation

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A senior project manager (SPM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality, and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiation through Closing phases. However, the SPM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project managers role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders. The SPM is responsible for overseeing and performing project management functions on all Broadcast projects, budgets, and scopes. The SPM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities. Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for team participants, managing deliverables from the consulting team, and overseeing the completion of projects.
  
The SPM is responsible for completing consulting projects on time, on budget and achieving high levels of customer satisfaction from our customers. Most of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes. As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship. They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications, and satisfaction.
  
  

**Location:** Preferred Northeast or Southeast
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to Media and Entertainment’s consulting projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, internal and external consultants and subject matter experts, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members. Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Coordinates all deliverable documentation between all internal and external stakeholders. Facilitates and directs document reviews to assure proper documentation is delivered to the client. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates transition of projects to later phase project teams.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different, and project stakeholders are different. The SPM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between discovery, analysis, conceptual design, and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence, and people management skills. The SPM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality, and client satisfaction are a very complex set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

* Takes full ownership of project
* Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
* Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client satisfaction.
* Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
* Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
* Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
* Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole decision maker.


**Physical Demands:**  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an employee. The employee will experience normal office conditions and be required to use office equipment such as computers, peripherals, etc.
  
  

**Travel:**  

Some travel by car and occasional airplane trips should be expected as much of our consulting work is conducted remotely with occasional in person meetings. Employee must possess a valid driver’s license in their state of residence. Employee will be required to use their own vehicle and will be reimbursed for mileage at the current corporate rate. 10% remote travel is not unusual.

jobs.description:
**Join the Avani Team**

**Position**: Human Resources Project Manager (Retirement \& Benefits)

**Salary**: Competitive compensation based on location, education, and experience.

**About Avani Services:**  
Avani Services is a growing company providing human capital, custom training, digital transformation, and professional support services for mission\-driven public and private\-sector clients.

We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Project Manager to support a government client’s federal retirement and employee benefits program. This senior role combines deep subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring complex work is delivered on schedule, within scope, and to a high standard of quality.

**The Role:**  
The Human Resources Project Manager serves as a senior subject matter expert in federal retirement and benefits programs and independently leads high\-visibility, mission\-critical program activities. The Project Manager will oversee project plans, milestones, deliverables, status reporting, and quality control while recommending and coordinating improvements to business processes, policies, and procedures.

This individual will provide expert counseling and policy guidance; lead complex case resolution; develop training and standard operating procedures; and represent the program in engagements with OPM, other federal agencies, and benefit carriers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead retirement and benefits program activities, ensuring all work is completed on schedule, within established scope, and in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Develop and manage project plans, milestones, status reports, deliverables, risks, and quality\-control processes.
* Serve as the senior subject matter expert on federal retirement and benefits programs, including CSRS, FERS, FEHB, FEGLI, TSP, FERCCA, Social Security, and applicable military\-service provisions.
* Provide expert counseling and advisory services to employees, retirees, beneficiaries, managers, and senior leadership, including on highly sensitive, complex, or contested cases.
* Interpret and apply federal laws, regulations, policies, and guidance; prepare policy interpretations, decision papers, and sensitive correspondence.
* Lead the development, update, and implementation of SOPs, policy guidance, and business\-process improvements for HR staff.
* Review, resolve, and oversee corrective actions for complex FERCCA cases and related compliance matters.
* Analyze legislative and regulatory changes; recommend enterprise\-wide actions and guide implementation.
* Develop and deliver retirement and benefits training, orientations, briefings, and other learning materials for employees and leadership.
* Represent the organization in interagency workgroups and stakeholder engagements with OPM, other federal agencies, and benefit carriers.
* Coordinate the work of assigned staff, as applicable, and ensure deliverables meet customer expectations and planned timelines.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of progressive HR experience, including substantial experience leading federal retirement and employee benefits programs.
* Comprehensive knowledge of federal retirement and benefits laws, regulations, and policies, including CSRS, FERS, FEHB, FEGLI, TSP, and FERCCA.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing high\-visibility or mission\-critical projects and delivering work within established schedules and scope.
* Experience developing project plans, milestones, status reports, SOPs, policy guidance, training materials, and other client deliverables.
* Proven ability to manage complex cases, resolve disputes, recommend practical technical solutions, and improve business processes.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leadership and represent the organization externally.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, quality\-management, and program\-management skills.
* U.S. citizenship is required by contract.
* Ability to obtain and maintain the required DHS background investigation or security clearance.

**Equal Opportunity** 

Avani is an Equal Opportunity Employer, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us to discuss any specific needs.

Base Pay: From $110,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* This position is subject to a U.S. citizenship requirement under the applicable federal contract. Are you a U.S. citizen?
* If selected, are you willing to undergo and successfully complete the required DHS background investigation?

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Project Manager - 3 month Contract - Parental Leave Coverage
jobs.description:
**About Beazley Security**


Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017\. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients.

  

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world\-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

**Parental Leave Coverage (Contract Opportunity)**
==================================================

**This is a temporary parental leave coverage role, with an anticipated start date in mid\-October and an expected duration through the end of January or February. During this period, the individual will provide full support for the responsibilities of the position, ensuring continuity of operations and a seamless experience for internal and external stakeholders while the team member is on leave.**

**Summary**


As a Project Manager at Beazley Security, you will be responsible for overseeing and delivering cybersecurity projects from initiation to completion, for our cyber services team. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, clients, and stakeholders to ensure that projects are executed efficiently, on time, and within scope and budget. This role requires strong project management skills, knowledge of cybersecurity, and excellent communication abilities.

**Responsibilities**


Project Planning and Initiation:* Collaborate with clients and internal teams to define project objectives, scope, and requirements.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets.
* Identify and allocate resources required for project execution.
* Conduct project kickoff meetings and communicate project goals to the team.


Project Execution and Monitoring:* Lead project teams in executing cybersecurity projects.
* Monitor project progress and track key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Identify and mitigate project risks and issues.
* Ensure that project deliverables meet quality standards and client expectations.


Stakeholder Communication:* Maintain clear and regular communication with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
* Provide project status updates, reports, and documentation as needed.
* Manage client expectations and address concerns promptly.


Resource Management:* Coordinate and allocate resources, including personnel, tools, and equipment.
* Manage project budgets and ensure adherence to financial constraints.


Quality Assurance:* Ensure that all project activities comply with cybersecurity industry standards and best practices.
* Perform quality control and assurance checks on project deliverables.


Change Management:* Partner with business stakeholders to document change requests that impact project scope, budget utilization, and/or resourcing
* Effectively manage project scope changes and assess their impact on timelines and budgets.
* Ensure that change requests are documented and approved by relevant stakeholders.


Project Closure:* Conduct post\-project evaluation and gather lessons learned.
* Prepare and deliver project closure reports to clients and management.

**Technical Knowledge \& Project Delivery**

* Develop a working understanding of Managed Extended Detection and Response (MXDR) services, including security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response workflows.
* Understand how security telemetry and log sources are collected, ingested, and monitored within a Security Operations Center (SOC) environment.
* Partner closely with Security Engineering teams to identify onboarding prerequisites, validate data collection methods, and prioritize high\-value security telemetry.
* Facilitate discussions with clients regarding scope, timelines, technical dependencies, and onboarding requirements to ensure successful project delivery.
* Support planning and coordination of security tool integrations, including understanding licensing, configuration, and infrastructure requirements that may impact implementation.
* Assist in evaluating and prioritizing security data sources based on business objectives, visibility requirements, and threat detection value.
* Serve as a liaison between clients and technical teams, translating complex security concepts into clear business language.
* Manage projects in a dynamic environment where priorities, scope, and timelines may evolve based on technical findings and client needs.
* Maintain alignment across clients, Project Management, and Security Engineering teams throughout implementation to ensure successful onboarding and acceptance.
* Measure project success through the successful deployment, validation, and operationalization of agreed\-upon security telemetry and monitoring capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in project management, with a focus on IT or cybersecurity projects.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
*

jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE:** Senior Clinical Project Manager/ Clinical Project Manager


**DEPARTMENT:** Global Project Delivery

  



**Ora Values the Daily Practice of …**


*Prioritizing Kindness \* Operational Excellence \* Cultivating Joy \* Scientific Rigor*

  

At Ora, we are building the future of ophthalmic clinical research. As the world’s leading full\-service ophthalmic drug and device development firm, we guide our clients across all phases of clinical research to efficiently bring new products and therapies to market. Over the past 45 years, our expert teams have helped earn more than 85 new product approvals. Ora's pre\-clinical and clinical models, unique methodologies, integrated clinical data solutions, and global regulatory strategies have been refined and proven across thousands of global projects.Today, our team continues to expand across the globe, with over 600 employees across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.


**The Role:**


Ora’s Senior Clinical Project Managers (Sr. CPM) are critical in driving clinical ophthalmic projects forward utilizing best practices in order to ensure budgets, timelines, and clinical trial requirements are being met on behalf of the sponsor. This role will work independently to manage cross functional project teams as well as overseeing other projects they are not directly managing, as a senior member of the clinical operations team, to provide support to more junior team members. Sr. CPM’s have active involvement in each assigned project in order to meet milestones, resolve issues and/ or conflicts in addition to frequent interactions with the study team including but not limited to clinical trial associates, monitoring, clinical research coordinators, investigators and senior management. They are responsible for creating project plans and provide weekly budget and progress reviews for each study in addition to preparing high\-quality reports.


**What You’ll Do:**


* May manage department Clinical Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Clinical Trial Associates and other supporting staff.
* Manages cross functional project teams derived from the groups within clinical development to deliver a high\-quality clinical trial(s) in compliance with all regulations and SOPs.
* Works with functional areas on initiating, planning, executing, controlling, closing and resourcing clinical trial projects. The CPM acts as an operational nexus or focal point for interdepartmental and intradepartmental groups (e.g. stats, data management, safety, manufacturing, regulatory, vendors), coordinating these different groups in a matrix environment to drive and complete clinical programs.
* Reviews protocol, source documents and CRFs and tracks them to completion.
* Responsible for creating and maintaining project timelines for each project and uses these timelines to track and manage a project’s progress.
* Responsible for creating Project Plans (Roles and Responsibility Tables and Communication Plans) and weekly project budget and progress reviews for each study.
* Reviews study metrics for performance and quality with the team and management.
* Prepares high\-quality reports (financial, project, etc.) for management on program status and issues.
* Ensures review of clinical electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) for completeness.
* Manages and coordinates all vendors involved in the clinical trials (e.g. central labs, IVRS, reading centers).
* May represent Ora at professional meetings or seminars.
* Participates in preparing new study budgets, proposal documents and participating in bid defenses.
* Active role in department and company\-wide process improvement initiatives.
* Travel of up to 15% is required (mainly domestic, overnight).
* Adhere to all aspects of Ora’s quality system.
* Adhere to all essential systems and processes that are required at Ora to maintain compliance to Ora’s data integrity \& business ethics and regulatory requirements.

Clear and sustained demonstration of Ora’s values * \- prioritizing kindness, operational excellence, cultivating joy and scientific rigor – as well as their linked behaviors.
* Responsibilities may differ from the above based on the specific needs of the business.

**What We Look For:**

* *Experience needed for the Role:*
* + Bachelors’ degree in Life Science with at least 7 years of clinical trial experience. Years of experience may be considered in lieu of education
	+ Minimum of 3 years of clinical project management experience.
* *Additional Skills \& Attributes:*
* + Ophthalmology experience preferred.
	+ Understanding of multi\-center drug and/or device trials.
	+ Experience with Veeva TMF and CTMS systems.
	+ Ability to establish and maintain effective professional relationships with co\-workers, managers and clients.
	+ Highly effective organizational and communication skills.
	+ Ability to plan, identify risks, anticipate issues and outcomes and respond strategically, tactically and operationally while balancing short\-term and long\-term company objectives.
	+ Demonstrated expertise of applicable regulatory requirements and GCP.
	+ Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to multitask and to solve problems proactively.
	+ Proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint and vendor management.
	+ Multi\-lingual communication is a plus
* *Competencies and Personal Traits:*
* + **What We Do:**
	+ - **Execution Excellence:** Ability to set goals, create structure and maintain a focused and collaborative approach to the delivery of timely and high\-quality work.
	+ **How We Do It:**
	+ - **IQ, EQ and SQ:** Agile and positive thinker, communicator and collaborator who uses a growth mindset to work and lead with authenticity, transparency, resilience, and empathy. Scientific, intellectual, and emotional/social curiosity creates the willingness and ability to innovate, make mistakes, learn and try again.

The CDW Project Manager is a trusted consultant, providing project management expertise across multiple technology stacks and services. Projects are typically of low to medium complexity and incorporate mainstream, legacy and emerging technologies. The Project Manager may independently manage projects, or work within a large program under the guidance of Program Managers. This position works with mixed teams consisting of CDW engineers, CDW sales, other members of CDW cross functional business areas, customer staff, and third\-party consultants.
