Job Title: Project Manager, National Technical Assistance and Coordination Center



Location: Bethesda, Maryland (Remote)



Reports To: Director, Technical Assistance Implementation and Partnerships



FLSA Status: Exempt



Must be able to provide proof of residence in one of these states: KS, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, TN, TX, PA, VA, WA, WV, and DC



\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_


#### **About NACHC:**


Founded in 1971, the National Association of Community Health Centers (NACHC) serves as the leading voice for America’s Health Centers and the people and communities they serve. NACHC works to promote the provision of high\-quality, affordable, community\-based health care to everyone, particularly to underserved populations.



\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_


#### **Position Summary:**


Responsible for project management and implementation activities related to the National Technical Assistance Program Cooperative Agreement. This position requires technical oversight and quality assurance. Working in close coordination and collaboration with the supervisor, this position will ensure that relevant projects meet the compliance and reporting standards required by federal funders, as well as additional needs of internal teams and external partners.



\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_


#### **Key Responsibilities:**


1\) Strategic Implementation: Responsible for overall effective project management and execution of NACHC’s National TA Program (NTAP) Cooperative Agreement in coordination with supervisor.

* Develop and/or support systems to manage projects that include clear workflows, automation, and reporting dashboards, ensuring that the approach aligns with NACHC’s overall project management approach/systems.
* Develop, maintain, and evaluate standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure clarity, efficiency, and compliance for internal team members.
* Identify opportunities for improvement of existing functionality, troubleshooting, and collaborate with other project managers (as applicable) to develop training materials for staff on how to use project management tools and other applicable systems/trackers.
* Set implementation priorities and provide communication and coordination with internal teams and external partners including the federal funder.
* Track project, grant, funder, and other deliverables/progress as applicable.
* Identify when/if a project or deliverable is off track and alert relevant team members, partners, and funders.
* Review and analyze project data to ensure the accuracy of information.
* Report on status, milestones, deliverables, outcomes, and lessons learned to all applicable parties both in written form and verbally as needed.
* Use analytical tools to track outcomes.


2\) Technical Oversight and Quality Assurance: Monitor and ensure compliance with federal program goals and requirements consistent with federal oversight

* Guide the daily execution of the National TA Program Cooperative Agreement ensuring alignment with funder and NACHC requirements.
* Ensure programs adhere to federal policies, HRSA standards, and other local, state, and federal regulations as applicable.
* Oversee endtoend review and clearance process for technical assistance (TA) resources and presentation materials, including internal quality assurance reviews, coordination and tracking of HRSA review and approval, and final dissemination, posting, or delivery of approved materials.
* Develop, maintain and oversee internal quality review process for all NTAPfunded TA products, resources, and presentations.
* Ensures NACHC NTAP website is updated with all cleared TA resources and events.
* In close coordination with supervisor, provide oversight for the Health Center Resource Clearinghouse contract and tracks timely execution of deliverables.


3\) Business Operations and Financial Stewardship: Oversee assigned project budgets, manage funding cycles, and ensure that all fiscal operations comply with funding requirements in collaboration with supervisor and other internal teams and the federal funder, when applicable.

* Track spenddown, conduct financial reviews and programmatic audits, identify risks, and recommend actions to supervisor.
* Analyze and interpret funder requirements and NACHC policies to develop, update, and execute Standard Operating Procedures.
* Analyze and measure the effectiveness of existing processes and develop sustainable, repeatable, and quantifiable process improvements.
* Provide supervision to external consultants as applicable.


4\) Cross\-Functional Coordination: Build internal and external relationships, and ensure coordination

* Coordinate project management approaches with NACHC colleagues to ensure enterprisewide coordination.
* Work closely within HCOG and with other functional areas to track project execution and ensure adherence to program requirements.
* Lead or participate in crossfunctional project teams, assign tasks, and track progress through project completion as applicable.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with NACHC internal teams and external partners including funders.


5\) Procurement: Support Procurement RFP, RFI, and Other Procurement Processes

* Coordinate with HCOG Business Operations team, supervisor, and other internal team members to determine specific procurement needs.
* Maintain standards, best practices, and templates required to assist SMEs in creating RFPs, RFIs, and/or other procurement processes (e.g., mentors, discussion leaders, etc.).
* Follow organizational and programspecific procedures for reviewing RFPs/RFIs/other procurement, properly organize and maintain vendor records, review materials, and scoring guidance under established best practices and internal policies.


6\) Organizational Collaboration: Contribute to NACHC’s overall programming

jobs.title: Project Manager - Facility Condition Assessments & Capital Planning
jobs.description:
**Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC)** is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions that provide reliable power and modernize infrastructure. Since 2000, we have served as a trusted partner to public and private sector customers across North America, the UK and Europe, delivering over **$15 billion in solutions** and contracting more than **5 GW of energy resources**.

  

At Ameresco, we integrate energy resources and modernize the built environment through innovative infrastructure solutions that improve reliability, optimize performance, strengthen resilience, and support long\-term sustainability. Join us in building the infrastructure that powers the future. Explore opportunities to make a meaningful impact while growing your career with a company at the forefront of energy innovation.

  

Ameresco has an immediate opening for a **Project Manager – Facility Condition Assessments \& Capital Planning**. The Project Manager is responsible for leading Facility Condition Assessment (FCA), asset management, and capital planning projects for primarily Municipal, University, School District, and Healthcare (MUSH) clients. This role oversees the successful delivery of projects from initiation through completion, ensuring that scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations are consistently achieved.

  

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of contact for clients and coordinates multidisciplinary teams responsible for facility assessments, asset inventories, capital planning analyses, data management, reporting, and software implementation activities. The position requires strong project leadership, technical knowledge of building systems, and the ability to translate facility data into actionable capital planning strategies. Successful candidate will report to the Senior Director of Capital Planning.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

### **Project Leadership \& Delivery**

* Manage multiple FCA and capital planning projects simultaneously.
* Develop project work plans, schedules, budgets, and staffing plans.
* Lead project kickoff meetings and ongoing client communications.
* Monitor project progress and ensure adherence to contractual requirements.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Manage project financial performance, including labor budgets, invoicing support, and change management.

### **Client Management**

* Serve as the primary client contact throughout project delivery.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients.
* Facilitate project meetings, workshops, and executive presentations.
* Understand client objectives and align project deliverables with strategic facility and capital planning goals.
* Support business development activities through client engagement and proposal development participation.

### **Technical Oversight**

* Direct facility condition assessments of buildings, infrastructure, and site assets.
* Oversee assessment methodologies, quality assurance processes, and data collection standards.
* Review facility condition indices (FCI), renewal forecasts, and capital planning recommendations.
* Ensure consistency and accuracy of asset inventories and condition data.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts in architecture, engineering, energy, and asset management disciplines.

### **Data \& Capital Planning Management**

* Oversee data collection, validation, and integration into capital planning platforms.

**Location:** United States Remote  

**Shift:** 8 am – 5 pm Pacific Time  

**Work Style:** Collaborative, client\-facing


This is a **contract\-to\-hire** opportunity, with the potential to transition to a regular full\-time role based on business needs and successful performance during the contract period.


**The Opportunity**


Inviso is looking for an experienced Marketing Project Manager to help lead \& run the day\-to\-day delivery of several key B2B marketing programs. This role serves as a trusted client partner and the central point of coordination across strategy, content, creative, production, and reporting. You will turn business goals into clear plans, keep teams aligned, and deliver high\-quality work on time and within budget.


The ideal candidate is an organized, proactive communicator who is comfortable managing multiple workstreams, navigating changing priorities, and creating clarity in a fast\-moving environment. Experience supporting technology, cloud, AI, data, cybersecurity, or professional services marketing is a plus.


**What You Will Do**


* Build strong client relationships grounded in trust, responsiveness, and a clear understanding of business goals.
* Lead projects from intake through delivery, including scope, schedule, creative kickoff, proofing, approvals, and final closeout.
* Translate campaign objectives into actionable project plans, creative briefs, timelines, and next steps.
* Coordinate cross\-functional contributors across account management, content development, design, digital, operations, and sometimes external partners.
* Ability to perform first\-pass reviews of presentations, marketing content, and client deliverables to ensure clarity, consistency, completeness, and alignment with project objectives.
* Manage integrated deliverables such as email campaigns, web and landing\-page content, presentations, social content, digital assets, customer stories, white papers, infographics, and sales enablement materials.
* Facilitate client and internal meetings, document decisions, and ensure owners and next steps are clear.
* Anticipate risks, resolve roadblocks, manage scope changes, and communicate tradeoffs before they affect quality, timing, or budget.
* Provide thoughtful recommendations and options when challenges arise, helping clients make informed decisions rather than simply reporting status.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and status reporting in project management and collaboration tools.
* Partner with the team to review campaign performance, identify optimization opportunities, and capture lessons learned.
* Improve repeatable processes, templates, and ways of working that increase quality, visibility, and efficiency.


**What You Bring**


* 5\+ years of marketing project management, account management, or integrated campaign delivery.
* Demonstrated success managing multiple complex programs and deliverables from start to finish.
* Strong client\-facing communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Working knowledge of B2B marketing channels, content development, creative production, campaign operations, and performance reporting.
* Ability to connect project decisions to broader campaign, business, and client objectives.
* Ability to create practical schedules and budgets, manage dependencies, and keep work moving across multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and attention to detail.
* Confidence using Microsoft 365 and modern project management and collaboration tools(Asana); familiarity with AI\-assisted content creation, review, or project management workflows is a plus; experience with Microsoft clients or ecosystem marketing is helpful but not required.
* Comfort operating and creating structure in a high\-volume environment with shifting priorities and deadlines.
* A solution\-oriented mindset, sound judgment, and a willingness to take ownership.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.


**What Success Looks Like**


* Clients have confidence in the plan, progress, and quality of delivery.
* Teams understand priorities, responsibilities, decisions, and deadlines.
* Projects are delivered on time, within approved scope and budget, and with fewer last\-minute surprises.
* Risks and roadblocks are surfaced early and addressed with clear options.
* Project documentation and reporting provide useful visibility for clients and internal leaders.


**Compensation**


At Inviso, we believe great talent should be rewarded with competitive pay, meaningful benefits, and room to grow. The base pay for this role ranges from **$80,000 to $95,000** annually, reflecting the cost of labor across multiple US geographic markets. Actual compensation will be determined by factors such as location, job\-related skills, experience, education or training, and the needs of Inviso’s different lines of business. Beyond base pay, we offer a strong benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, annual training reimbursement, paid time off, paid holidays, and additional perks designed to support your well\-being and long\-term success.


**About Inviso**


Inviso is a global consulting firm specializing in Data \& AI, Cloud Infrastructure, Marketing, and Sales solutions. We partner with enterprise organizations worldwide to solve complex business challenges and deliver measurable impact.


Our reputation is built on technical excellence, customer success, and a people\-first culture. We invest in our employees through continuous learning, mentorship, collaboration, and career development opportunities across a diverse global organization.


Join a team where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work has a direct impact on some of the world's most recognized brands.

**Project Manager Data Management and Artificial Intelligence (Remote)**


Rothe is seeking a Project Manager specializing in Data Management and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to provide remote project management support for the Chief Data and Artificial Intelligence Office in support of the NASA Enterprise Multimedia and Integrated Technical Services (eMITS) contract. eMITS is the Agency’s enterprise\-level contract creating and delivering multimedia and technical communications through the use of the internet, digital platforms, and IT management for NASA’s Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and Office of Communications (OCOMM). From photographing rocket launches and recoveries, to producing engaging videos, to information technology management, to using social media to share NASA’s message, eMITS integrates services for NASA IT and provides NASA’s communication to the outside world. Come join us in support of NASA’s mission to inspire the world through information and discovery.


**Job Description:**


Provide comprehensive programmatic, strategic, and technical support to the Chief Data Officer (CDO), Chief Artificial Intelligence Officer (CAIO), and broader CDAIO teams. The role spans policy development, governance, data/AI strategy execution, workforce training, and multi\-center coordination to advance NASA’s Data Strategy and AI maturity.


**Functional Responsibilities:**


Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


Policy, Governance, and Compliance


* Lead development, coordination, and implementation of data and AI policies, including governance standards, metadata and classification frameworks, interoperability models, and compliance enforcement mechanisms.
* Conduct policy gap assessments, manage exception processes, monitor compliance, and support consensus\-building across NASA centers and external partners.


AI and Data Risk Management


* Develop and maintain AI risk assessment methodologies aligned with NIST AI RMF, including bias testing, safety validation, and ongoing performance monitoring for deployed models.
* Identify risks, create risk statements, mitigation plans, and impact analyses.


Strategic Planning \& Inter\-Organizational Coordination


* Facilitate inter\-organizational planning and coordination to meet federal requirements and support NASA’s Data Strategy, Data Action Plan goals, and enterprise milestones.
* Provide project and program management support aligned with IT, data, and AI domain knowledge, applying cost/schedule/performance metrics.


Training, Workforce Development \& Media Support


* Develop and coordinate training materials, briefings, and workforce development strategies to improve NASA\-wide proficiency in AI and data competencies.
* Assess workforce skill gaps and produce tailored curricula and career progression maps for data/AI roles.


Data Management \& Technical Architecture


* Implement enterprise\-level data management practices such as ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, metadata standards, and interoperability frameworks.
* Promote responsible, ethical, secure, and transparent adoption of AI capabilities.


Stakeholder Engagement \& Working Groups


* Facilitate and support agency\-wide boards, working groups, and governance bodies such as ITSB, EDWG, AISB, and AISWG.


General Support Services


* Provide strategic advisory, content development, governance support, communications coordination, and continuous service improvement across CDAIO initiatives.


Remote, hybrid, and onsite positions, the employee bears travel costs to the nearest NASA Center for badging and the issuance of NASA IT equipment.


For a Remote or Hybrid position, the employee must have a reliable internet connection and be able to VPN into the NASA network to conduct work.


**Education and Experience:**


Minimum Education: BA BA/BS Data Science, Information Management, Business Administration, or a related field.


Minimum Experience: 8 years


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years of project management experience.
* 6\+ years of experience in data governance, data management, or a related field, preferably within a federal or large organizational setting.
* Provide expert strategic vision and management services informed by industry best practices to guide efficient and effective data management and AI adoption.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Knowledge of AI and data governance and risk frameworks.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to provide IT clarification as it relates to AI.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Proficient in M365
* Jira
* Microsoft Purview
* Collibra, Informatica, etc.
* Strategy Management
* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) Certification (desired, not required)
* ITIL Certification (desired, not required)
* Microsoft Project (desired, not required)
* Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, OneDrive), SharePoint, and Box.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Latent Health**
-----------------------


Latent Health is redefining how healthcare systems unlock the power of clinical data. Through our AI\-powered platform, we streamline clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve health system efficiency. We partner with leading hospitals and health systems to deliver fast, reliable, and high\-impact implementations that transform patient care.

**Role Overview**
=================


The **Implementation Project Manager** is responsible for leading end\-to\-end onboarding and deployment projects for health systems adopting Latent’s platform. You’ll drive timelines, coordination, communication, and successful activation across clinical, IT, integration, and operational stakeholders.


This role requires exceptional organization, customer\-facing presence, and the ability to operate in the dynamic environment of a high\-growth healthcare SaaS startup. You will ensure customers go live efficiently, achieve measurable value quickly, and are set up for long\-term success.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Project Leadership \& Customer Delivery**

* Lead full\-cycle implementation projects – from kickoff through go\-live and stabilization – across a portfolio of health system customers.
* Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and risk logs.
* Facilitate cross\-functional meetings with customer IT, clinical operations, and technical teams (e.g., data integration, SSO, EHR workflows).
* Serve as the primary project point of contact, ensuring exceptional communication and alignment across all parties.

### **Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate collection and validation of required technical inputs (integration specifications, data feeds, configuration requirements).
* Partner with Latent engineering, product, and clinical teams to ensure smooth handoffs and timely execution.
* Understand and translate technical requirements to non\-technical stakeholders (and vice versa).
* Monitor progress of integrations (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech) and escalate blockers proactively.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Own project documentation, including requirements tracking, decisions, status updates, risk mitigation plans, and post\-go\-live handoff materials.
* Build repeatable processes and contribute to the evolution of Latent’s implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Track and report project KPIs (e.g., activation timelines, milestone adherence, customer readiness).
* Ensure clean transition to Support teams post\-implementation.

### **Customer Relationship \& Change Management**

* Build trusted relationships with clinical and operational leaders at customer sites.
* Guide customers through workflow adoption, training readiness, and change\-management planning.
* Ensure customer stakeholders understand project expectations, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Drive customer accountability to keep projects on track and on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

### **Required**

* 3\-7 years of project management experience in healthcare, SaaS implementations, or health IT.
* Strong understanding of healthcare environments – clinical operations, IT workflows, data integrations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication, meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and navigate competing priorities.
* Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, Monday.com).
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

### **Preferred**

* Experience implementing solutions with EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Meditech).
* PMP, CSM, or other project management certification.
* Background in clinical workflow optimization or healthcare operations.
* Prior experience in Series A\-C SaaS or health\-tech companies.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**
===================================

* Customers consistently launch on time, on budget, and with high satisfaction.
* Clear, proactive communication minimizes surprises and escalations.
* Implementation cycles shorten over time due to improved processes and customer readiness.
* Cross\-functional teams view you as a trusted coordinator and problem\-solver.
* Customers transition seamlessly to Customer Success with strong early adoption signals.

**Why Latent Health**
=====================

* Mission\-driven team transforming healthcare through cutting\-edge AI.
* Fast\-growing environment with opportunities for career growth.
* Deep collaboration across clinical, technical, and product teams.
* A chance to make a real impact on clinician workflows and patient outcomes.

  

Compensation Range: $115K \- $175K

jobs.title: Project Manager - Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
#### **Who We Are**


Xtensys is a rapidly growing managed service provider delivering innovative technology solutions to health systems, beginning in New York and expanding nationwide. Owned by two industry leaders with a strong focus on advancing rural and community healthcare, Xtensys is executing several major initiatives and scaling quickly. With a team of more than 500 professionals, we are building a people\-centered culture rooted in collaboration, innovation, and strategic thinking.



We are seeking an experienced Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives to lead cross\-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the organization. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Initiatives, this position partners with technology, clinical, operational, business, and other stakeholders to plan and execute projects that advance organizational priorities.



Projects will vary based on organizational priorities and may include healthcare technology implementations, enterprise applications, system integrations, clinical and business systems, operational and process improvements, cybersecurity and risk initiatives, vendor implementations, and other strategic or cross\-functional projects assigned. The role also performs business analysis activities, including requirements gathering, workflow and process documentation, and translating business objectives into actionable project plans.


#### **How We Work:**

* East Coast Alignment: Our core operational and collaboration hours follow the Eastern Time Zone (ET), keeping our workflows synchronized with our primary clients and systems.

#### **Why Join Us?**

* MissionDriven Work: You are the "bridge" ensuring technology serves health systems and their patients when they need it most.
* Autonomy \& Ownership: We trust you. You’ll lead projects, define success, and manage complexities with total support.
* A Culture of Innovation: Have a fresh perspective? We want it. We encourage risktaking and continuous improvement.
* Continuous Growth: We fuel your "restless curiosity" with opportunities to expand your skillset and mentor others.


The Role: This is an experienced\-level project management position requiring a current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification and demonstrated success managing projects within healthcare IT or healthcare technology environments. The Project Manager, Strategic Initiatives, independently manages assigned projects from initiation through implementation and closeout while exercising sound judgment regarding risks, priorities, stakeholder needs, and issues requiring escalation.


#### **Work Arrangement:**

* Work arrangement will be based on business needs and the requirements of assigned projects. The role requires effective collaboration with geographically distributed teams and availability during established business hours and projectrelated meetings.

#### **Your Mission: What You’ll Do Day\-to\-Day:**

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned projects through the full project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, implementation, and closeout.
* Partner with project sponsors and stakeholders to define objectives, scope, requirements, deliverables, timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and measures of success.
* Develop and maintain project charters, project plans, schedules, work breakdown structures, communication plans, risk and issue logs, decision logs, status reports, and other project documentation as appropriate.
* Perform business analysis activities by gathering and documenting business and functional requirements and assisting with currentstate and futurestate process and workflow documentation.
* Coordinate project activities across technical, clinical, operational, business, vendor, and other stakeholder groups; establish clear roles, responsibilities, expectations, and deadlines.
* Track project scope, schedule, milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, decisions, action items, and, when applicable, budget; identify deviations and coordinate corrective action.
* Proactively identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, constraints, and resource challenges; escalate concerns appropriately when leadership decisions or support are required.
* Manage changes to project scope, requirements, timelines, and deliverables using established project governance and changecontrol practices.
* Develop and execute project communication plans and provide timely, accurate status updates to project sponsors, stakeholders, and leadership.
* Schedule and facilitate project meetings, working sessions, status reviews, and decision forums that result in clear actions, owners, and accountability.
* Build effective working relationships across departments and lead through coordination and influence in a matrixed environment.
* Coordinate activities with thirdparty vendors, consultants, and implementation partners; track commitments, dependencies, deliverables, and performance.
* Support project implementation, transition, closeout, and lessonslearned activities and identify opportunities to improve project delivery practices.
* Support the Director of Strategic Initiatives with organizational priorities, special projects, and crossfunctional initiatives as assigned.


Who You Are \& What You’ll Bring


* 35 years of progressively responsible project management experience, including demonstrated experience independently managing complex, crossfunctional IT or technologyenabled projects.
* Demonstrated project management experience within healthcare IT, healthcare technology, a health system, or a similarly complex healthcare environment.
* Experience coordinating projects involving multiple technical, clinical, operational, business, and/or vendor stakeholder groups.
* Experience with project planning, requirements gathering, process and workflow documentation, risk and issue management, change control, stakeholder management, and status reporting

jobs.description:
**Home Infusion Intake Coordinator**
====================================



**100% Remote**

**Please note: Candidates must have previous Intake, Benefits Verification, or Authorization experience in a Home Infusion, Specialty Pharmacy, or Infusion Center setting.**

**Join Advanced Infusion Care**
-------------------------------



Advanced Infusion Care (AIC), a division of AIS Healthcare, is the leading provider of home infusion therapies and specialty pharmacy services. Guided by our core values of Innovation, Stewardship, and Unity, we are committed to Advancing Quality and Improving Lives for the patients, providers, and communities we serve.



We are seeking an experienced Intake Coordinator to join our growing team. This is a critical role responsible for ensuring patients have timely access to life\-changing infusion therapies by managing insurance verification, benefits investigation, prior authorizations, and patient onboarding activities.



If you thrive in a fast\-paced healthcare environment, have strong infusion intake experience, and enjoy helping patients navigate complex insurance requirements, we'd love to hear from you.



**Why Join AIS Healthcare?**
----------------------------



We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:



* 100% Remote Work Opportunity
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Company\-Paid Life Insurance
* Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Career Growth and Advancement Opportunities
* Collaborative Team Environment
* Mission\-Driven Culture Focused on Patient Care

**Position Summary**
--------------------



The Intake Coordinator is responsible for providing patient access to infusion therapies by verifying insurance eligibility, reviewing benefits, obtaining authorizations, and coordinating communication between patients, providers, nursing, pharmacy, and sales teams.



This role requires a strong understanding of infusion reimbursement, medical and pharmacy benefits, prior authorizations, and patient onboarding workflows.


**This is not a general medical intake position. Candidates must have prior experience working in a Home Infusion, Specialty Pharmacy, or Infusion Center environment.**



**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Enter patient, physician, insurance, and authorization information into company systems
* Review incoming referrals and prescription orders
* Contact patients and providers to obtain missing information
* Conduct comprehensive benefits investigations for new referrals
* Review both medical and pharmacy benefit plans
* Obtain clinical documentation needed for prior authorization submissions
* Follow authorizations through approval and resolution
* Communicate authorization status updates to patients, providers, and internal teams
* Manage denials and assist providers with appeals and peer\-to\-peer review processes
* Educate patients regarding coverage and financial responsibility
* Coordinate care across Nursing, Pharmacy, Sales, and Reimbursement teams
* Assist patients with manufacturer assistance programs and financial support options
* Maintain detailed documentation in patient records
* Identify alternate pharmacy providers when required by payer restrictions
* Support training and development of new team members
* Participate in process improvement initiatives and workflow optimization projects

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* High School Diploma or GED
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in:
	+ Home Infusion Intake
	+ Specialty Pharmacy Intake
	+ Infusion Center Intake
	+ Authorization or Benefits Verification within an infusion environment
* Experience with insurance verification, benefits investigation, and prior authorizations
* Strong understanding of medical and pharmacy benefits
* Excellent communication and customer service skills
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Advanced organizational and time management skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel

http://portal.cultureindex.com/public/survey/general/0BFB8F0000

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.description:
QA Lead to own software quality across Cidi Labs products.


### **About Cidi Labs**


Cidi Labs is a small but mighty company with a track record of providing innovative plugins for the Canvas LMS that over 600 educational institutions are using to enhance their online courses. We pride ourselves on our customer\-first obsession and the huge amount of love our customers feel for our products and team. Our company culture is one of kindness, fun, hard work and flexibility \- a great combo if we say so ourselves. If you love to delight customers and you want to work with a team that is passionate about making a difference in education, check out our job openings!
### **Description**


**Quality Assurance Lead**
--------------------------

### **Overview**


We're looking for a QA Lead to own software quality across Cidi Labs products. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead the QA effort among our developers by setting testing standards, guiding how quality is built into each feature, and holding the bar for every release.


Success requires becoming a product expert. You'll need to understand our applications, customer workflows, and expected behavior well enough to spot gaps in requirements and validate releases with confidence.

### **Responsibilities**

* Own release quality and define the testing strategy and standards across all products.
* Partner with developers so new features ship with appropriate unit and integration tests, and identify and close coverage gaps.
* Maintain a small, reliable end\-to\-end smoke suite covering critical user workflows.
* Strengthen CI/CD quality gates and establish quality metrics.
* Perform exploratory and regression testing, and investigate defects using browser developer tools, network traffic, logs, and API responses.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes.
* Work with Product, Engineering, and Business Analysts to improve requirement clarity and testability.
* Mentor developers and interns on testing best practices, fostering shared ownership of quality.

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3\+ years of experience in software quality assurance or test automation for web applications.
* Strong understanding of unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing strategies.
* Experience implementing automated testing in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience validating REST APIs with tools such as Postman.
* Ability to lead through influence, with excellent communication and collaboration skills.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience with PHP, React, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and frameworks such as PHPUnit, Jest, Vitest, or Playwright.
* Experience with GitLab CI/CD and cloud\-hosted SaaS applications.
* Knowledge of WCAG and accessibility testing.
* Experience in educational technology, instructional design, or Canvas LMS, including Cidi Labs products.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Higher unit and integration test coverage across all products, backed by a lean E2E smoke suite.
* Fewer regressions and greater release confidence.
* Developers consistently owning quality for the features they build.

 **What You'll Love About Cidi Labs**

* Great Company Culture
* Room to Grow your Career
* Flexible Time Off Policy
* 401(k) with a generous company match
* Fully remote work
* Health Benefits

 **Work Environment**


This role is performed primarily at a computer in a home or remote office setting. Join our team and be part of a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions will make a meaningful impact on the success of our clients and the growth of our organization.

  


#### **Salary**


$75,000 \- $90,000 per year

jobs.description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.



Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission\-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We're inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world\-class medicine through world\-class operations. \#LI\-MB1

**About the role:**
-------------------



We're looking for a Senior / Staff Analytics Program Lead to own the analytics product program across our global Analytics organization. While our solution analytics leads own the definitions and insights for a single solution, this role owns the analytics product function as a system: how analytics products get built, how they hold together across solutions, and how fast we can ship the next one. You are accountable for the coherence, quality, and velocity of everything the analytics function delivers, internal and external, and for steering the function toward more self\-serve and agentic analytics, where trusted metric definitions let customers, internal teams, and AI agents answer more questions without an analyst in the loop.



This is a hybrid role. Most of your time goes to running the program: enforcing and evolving the analytics standards and ways of working that let each pod ship correctly, scoping and sequencing work across solutions, and partnering with platform, data/BI engineering, and context architecture to shape the technical \& semantic foundations our analytics products are built on, especially as we scale towards enabling increased self\-service with AI tools. The rest is hands\-on. You will jump into a domain as an individual contributor when the hardest problems need you, both to unblock the team and to stay closely aligned the work you're setting the bar for. If you are energized by taking a pattern you know works and re\-establishing it at a broader scale, this is that role.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------



At Qventus, Analytics is treated as a first\-class product, rather than a secondary output. As the Analytics Program Lead, you will:


* Own delivery of coherent, high\-quality, on\-time analytics products across solutions, and hold the bar for products that are stable, maintainable, and easy to iterate and enhance over time
* Increase the velocity at which we build and ship analytics products by enforcing and shaping standards, developing analytics AI skills and context, and evolving team structures, in partnership with our Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product teams
* Lead the solution analytics leads as their manager, owning how the analytics team works day to day, scoping and sequencing work across solutions, and keeping people unblocked and focused
* Partner with our Data Platform Manager and Data Context \& Semantic Architect to shape the BI platform and semantic architecture that supports both our standard embedded analytics products and the move toward self\-service analytics (incl. Analytics agents)
* Stay hands\-on, contributing directly as an IC in a domain when the work demands it, to unblock the team and to keep close to the craft you're holding others to

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------


* Demonstrated program ownership of a technical function: you have scoped, sequenced, and shipped analytics or data work across multiple parallel workstreams and held ultimate responsibility for quality and coherence, not just your own output
* Strong analytical rigor: you can take an ambiguous question to a precise, defensible answer, with the hands\-on depth (SQL/dbt, modern warehouse and BI) to do the work yourself and set the standard, not just review against it
* A systems\-builder instinct: you turn what works into repeatable process, standards, and enforcement that keep running without you, rather than holding the function together through personal effort
* Cross\-functional influence across teams you don't directly control, with a track record of driving alignment when interpretations differ and holding durable working relationships with platform, engineering, and architecture partners
* Comfort with ambiguity and scale: you can take a coherent way of working that you've proven and re\-establish it at broader scale across solutions and teams

**It's a Plus if You Have…**
----------------------------


* Expertise in the healthcare domain and familiarity with healthcare operational data, clinical workflows, hospital operations, or common healthcare measurement challenges
* Experience scaling an analytics function at a growing company, taking something that worked at smaller scale and rebuilding it as a system others can run
* Familiarity with data governance, metric governance, or semantic layer concepts, especially where consistency across teams, solutions, or customer implementations is critical
* Experience with data logic implemented in dbt and data visualization in Sigma, and with knowledge management systems for documenting metric definitions and analytical decisions
* Exposure to AI\-enabled analytics, natural language analytics, or agentic analytics workflows, especially where high\-quality metric definitions and trusted analytical context are required for safe and useful AI outputs

jobs.title: Manager of Scaled Customer Success
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


Leadfeeder turns B2B websites into lead generation engines. Every day, potential buyers visit your website and leave without filling out a form. Leadfeeder reveals which companies are behind that traffic, shows what they care about, and helps teams act while interest is high.


By connecting website behavior with company data, intent signals, and automated workflows, Leadfeeder helps marketing and sales teams prioritise the right accounts and turn anonymous traffic into qualified pipeline.


We’re a remote\-first, international team building the next generation of lead generation technology for B2B marketers. Join us and help redefine how B2B companies generate leads from the signals already happening on their website.

**Position Overview**


Leadfeeder is modernising Customer Success to work at scale, not just at the top of the customer base. This role covers the majority of our customers, so how it's run shapes what most people experience after they buy.


The goal: a lifecycle where customers reach first value fast, build a habit, renew, and grow — supported by programs where programs do the job, and a named CSM where the relationship earns it.
  

  

The team delivers that lifecycle through three connected motions:

* Priority coverage — a smaller group of customers per region gets a named CSM, chosen by value concentration or risk.
* Digital programs — the long tail is covered without a named owner: triggered outreach, one\-to\-many programs (office hours, webinars), self\-serve content, and a shared expansion queue.
* Onboarding — every new customer on our mid\-tier package gets a live, round\-robin\-booked onboarding call.

  

We're hiring a Manager to own all three and decide, with evidence, how the team's time splits across them.


The operating model, segmentation, and capacity framework are already live — designed earlier this year. What's open is proving them out: testing capacity assumptions against real volume, turning usage and health signals into weekly targeting the team can act on, and finding where automation and AI genuinely help rather than add noise. If you like pressure\-testing a fresh model in the real world, this is the job. If you want a fully instrumented machine to optimise, it isn't.

**What you will do**

* **Run a multi\-motion coverage model**
* Own named coverage: a small CSM team working a defined portfolio — driving stalled adoption, securing renewals, stabilising at\-risk relationships.
* Own the digital long tail: triggered outreach, one\-to\-many programs, self\-serve enablement, a shared expansion queue, and clean hand\-offs to Support.
* Own onboarding: every eligible new customer gets a live first session; keep booking mechanics, volume, and completion rate healthy.
* Decide and defend the capacity split across the three. The current split is a working assumption — proving it out is one of your first jobs.

* **Build the digital program engine**
* Design programs that reach thousands of customers without a named owner: lifecycle campaigns, office hours, webinars, in\-product prompts, self\-serve paths.
* Decide where a human conversation earns its keep versus where a program does the job, and move the line as the evidence changes.
* Work closely with Marketing, Product, and Sales — most of this motion runs through channels CS doesn't own alone.

* **Turn signals into action**
* Read renewal load, expansion signals, and onboarding volume across the team every week, and act on them.
* Turn usage and health signals into thresholds: which patterns warrant a human conversation, which trigger a program, which are noise — sharpen these as you learn.
* Build reporting that gives an honest view of portfolio health, retention risk, and expected revenue movement.
* Feed what this team sees back into Product, Marketing, and Sales.

* **Use AI where it creates leverage**
* Apply AI to scale reach across the long tail and get more from the signals we already collect: health scoring, risk alerting, outreach personalisation, call prep.
* Ship AI where it genuinely changes the model's economics — don't run experiments that never launch. Use our internal AI ops team for support.
* Stay ahead of the curve on digital CS.

* **Develop the team commercially**
* Coach a small team who shift between three postures: individually accountable, program\-driven, high\-volume onboarding.
* Build skill in renewal, expansion, onboarding, and early risk conversations.
* Set expectations around outcomes — adoption improved, renewals secured, expansion surfaced — not activity cadences.
* Hire and develop as the team grows.

  
**Requirements**
----------------


Essential

* Experience running CS at scale — named coverage, pooled/tech\-touch, or a mix. Only run one? Show how you'd design and stand up the other.
* A track record of managing and developing people across genuinely different ways of working on one team.
* Real exposure to digital or programmatic CS within B2B SaaS: lifecycle campaigns, automated outreach, one\-to\-many enablement. You know what works at scale, not just what looks good in a deck.
* A commercial background or close to it: sales, RevOps, or a CS role carrying retention and expansion targets.
* Strong data literacy — the judgement to turn usage and health data into coverage decisions, not just dashboards.
* Practical AI fluency: you've put AI tools into a CS or RevOps workflow and made them stick.
* Comfort with a young operating model — you validate and adjust rather than wait for someone else to prove it first.


Nice to have

* Product\-led or high\-velocity SaaS experience, serving a large volume of smaller customers.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, Intercom, round\-robin scheduling, or sales engagement platforms.
* RevOps, Sales Ops, or CS Ops background alongside people management.

  
**Benefits**
------------

* The chance to work with a very knowledgeable, high\-achieving and fun team.
* An international, diver

jobs.description:
**Advanced Specialist, Implementation Specialist**

**About Pearson**

At Pearson, we’re committed to a world that’s always learning and to our talented team who makes it all possible.


**Role summary**

The Advanced Specialist, Implementation Specialist role drives end\-to\-end item and test development for large\-scale K–12 statewide assessment programs. This role serves as a primary client\-facing leader for content development; translates standards and blueprints into high\-quality item/test specifications; and coordinates cross\-functional work with Psychometrics, Content, Publishing Services, Program Delivery, and Finance. The Senior TDM provides thought leadership on assessment design, ensures operational excellence across paper and online modalities, and helps deliver successful outcomes for programs.


**Key responsibilities**

**Assessment leadership and client consulting**

* Provide expert guidance on assessment design, content development, and evidence\-based practices for statewide assessments, including summative, interim, and other assessment types.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for client\-facing content development requirements and educator committee meetings.

**Blueprinting, item/test specifications, and development**

* Translate standards and blueprints into actionable item and test specifications; secure client approvals and maintain documentation.
* Partner with Psychometrics on blueprint setup, test construction, data reviews, and standard setting inputs.
* Configure item bank metadata and test maps and oversee form assembly for paper and online administrations.

**Scope, financial management and schedules**

* Create, monitor and update labor and non\-salary forecasts for programs; participate in forecast and finance reconciliation meetings.
* Lead scope discussions with content development vendors; initiate SOWs and coordinate escalations as needed.
* Maintain and approve content development schedules; manage change control and document updates in agreed tools.

**Risk and issue management**

* Identify and log project\-specific risks; develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Troubleshoot item/test development issues; lead sustainable corrective actions to protect quality and timelines.

**Communication and customer experience**

* Create and execute communication plans for consistent, transparent updates to customers.
* Facilitate customer review meetings on milestones and deliverables; establish and track customer satisfaction measures.
* Define escalation pathways and ensure timely resolution with clear, documented communication.

**Team leadership and collaboration**

* Coordinate staffing with Content leadership; provide performance feedback and coaching to team members and vendor partners.
* Foster a positive, cohesive team environment; model strong negotiation and cross\-functional collaboration.

**AI Strategy and Management**

* Leverage AI\-powered tools to support the development, review, and enhancement of assessment content, ensuring outputs meet quality and accessibility standards and comply with program\-specific security and privacy requirements.
* Collaborate with team members to integrate AI\-generated assets into assessment workflows, providing feedback and editorial oversight, and documenting provenance and approvals per established processes.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies relevant to educational content creation and assessment; share practical guidance with the team and surface tool recommendations for consideration.

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in the educational testing and assessment industry, including client\-facing work and cross\-functional team leadership.
* Demonstrated expertise in item and test development for statewide K–12 assessments; experience across paper and online modalities.
* Knowledge of psychometric principles relevant to development.
* Experience with statewide assessments; classroom teaching experience valued.
* Proficiency with project and financial planning.
* Strong vendor management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and time management skills
* Adaptability with enterprise systems and tools.
* Ability to travel throughout the year, with increased travel during summer months.

**AI\-Related** **Qualifications**

* Demonstrated excellence in AI\-supported content development to leverage AI effectively in asset creation within a managed, compliant workflow.
* Experience or familiarity with prompting, refining, and evaluating AI\-generated content for educational assessments, including applying accessibility and bias checks.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new AI tools and methodologies as they evolve.

jobs.title: Implementation Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
**Elevate Patient Financial Solutions** has an exciting career opportunity available as an Implementation Enablement Specialist. This position will be remote based. The Full Time schedule for this role will be 8 AM\-5 PM, Monday\-Friday with flexibility as needed.
**Job Summary**  

The Implementation Enablement Specialist is responsible for the documentation, standardization, and continuous improvement of the processes used by the Implementation team. This position partners directly with the VP of Implementations to advance department\-wide initiatives, support technology build\-outs, and maintain consistent operating standards across every stage of the implementation lifecycle. This role designs and maintains workflow automations, owns the standardization of client data to ElevatePFS data values, and develops the reporting that gives implementation leadership visibility into capacity, go\-live progress, and delivery quality. The position is internal facing and requires strong prioritization skills, advanced proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and SharePoint, experience with monday.com, and familiarity with AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot or Claude.
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  

* Build, standardize, and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and templates across all service lines and each stage of the implementation lifecycle.
* Define and document cross\-team handoffs and go\-live readiness standards so that all teams operate from a consistent understanding of the process.
* Maintain a single, current source of truth for implementation processes and reference materials.
* Own the standardization of client data points to ElevatePFS standard data values, and build and maintain the automations that support that mapping.
* Design and maintain workflow automations, including monday.com boards and automations, file routing, and reconciliations, that reduce manual effort for the delivery teams.
* Evaluate repetitive, manual tasks across the department and determine which should be converted into documented, automated processes.
* Design and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting covering pipeline\-to\-capacity, go\-live and transition tracking, and quality and training trends.
* Analyze trends and surface risks or bottlenecks to implementation leadership with clear, decision\-ready recommendations.
* Translate delivery team pain points into concrete process, tooling, or automation improvements and coordinate their rollout.
* Develop onboarding materials and internal reference documentation to support the enablement of new implementers.
* Lead recurring reviews of implementation processes to identify and eliminate inefficiencies.
* Prioritize improvement initiatives by business impact and manage them from concept through documented, adopted change.

* Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to build reports and dashboards and translate data into clear, actionable insight.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: HR Generalist \- Onboarding and Employee Experience**


**Location: Remote/Hybrid \- USA**


**Reports to: HR Manager**


**Department Name: Human Resources**


**Job Types: Full Time – Exempt**


**Position Summary**



The HR Generalist \- Onboarding and Employee Experience owns the new hire experience from the point a candidate successfully completes all required pre\-employment screening through the employees’ first 90 days and beyond. This role coordinates a consistent, welcoming, and compliant onboarding process; connects new hires, managers, and internal partners; monitors early employee progress and engagement; and resolves issues that could disrupt a successful start.



The role provides backup coverage for the HR Generalist in areas of general People Operations support, including employee questions, HRIS administration, documentation, engagement, performance processes, and employee relations support. * Serve as the primary point of contact for new hires and hiring managers throughout preboarding and the first 90 days, providing clear expectations, timely communication, and prompt resolution of questions or barriers.
* Coordinate preboarding activities, including HRIS setup, new hire documentation, Form I\-9 requirements, policy acknowledgments, equipment and systems requests, payroll and benefits handoffs, orientation scheduling, and other required tasks.

* Administer and monitor applicable 30\-, 60\-, and 90\-day check\-ins and performance checkpoints; identify trends, missed commitments, engagement concerns, training gaps, and retention risks for follow\-up.
* Conduct new hire check\-ins and collect feedback from employees and managers to evaluate onboarding effectiveness and improve the experience.
* Maintain accurate onboarding records, dashboards, and status reports, including readiness, completion, time\-to\-productivity, early turnover, feedback, and other agreed\-upon measures.
* Standardize, document, and continuously improve onboarding workflows, templates, resources, and service\-level expectations across teams and worker populations.
* Ability to travel and/or work onsite as needed.
* Performs other duties as assigned or apparent.


**People Operations and Employee Support**


* Serve as a first point of contact for employee and manager questions regarding People policies, procedures, systems, and programs, escalating matters as appropriate.
* Process employee changes and maintain complete, accurate, and confidential employee records in the HRIS and personnel files.
* Audit HRIS data, Form I\-9 records, onboarding documents, and required acknowledgments for accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
* Support performance management, employee development, engagement, recognition, retention, leave administration, offboarding, and exit interview processes.
* Support employee relations matters and workplace reviews by gathering facts, documenting concerns, and partnering with People leadership to ensure fair and consistent treatment.
* Assist with implementation and communication of People policies, practices, and process changes in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local requirements.


**Supervisory Responsibilities:**


* This job has no direct supervisory responsibilities.
* The role provides process leadership by coordinating onboarding activities, guiding managers and new hires through required steps, and holding stakeholders accountable for timely completion.
* Serves as a resource for internal team members regarding Human Resources standards and operational processes.
* Supports knowledge sharing, continuous improvement initiatives, and best practices across the Human Resources function.


**Experience \& Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Two or more years of progressive Human Resources, People Operations, onboarding, or employee experience; experience supporting organizations with 200 or more employees or multiple locations is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating onboarding or other cross\-functional employee lifecycle processes from start to finish.
* Working knowledge of employment practices, Form I\-9 requirements, employee records, and HR compliance fundamentals.
* Proficiency with UKG Ready, UKG Pro, or a comparable HRIS; ability to use reporting and workflow tools to track completion and identify issues.
* PHR, SHRM\-CP, or similar certification is preferred.
* Strong project management, organization, and follow\-through, with the ability to manage multiple new hires, stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to create a welcoming, responsive experience fo

Hile Group, founded in 1991, is a dynamic performance consultancy specializing in workplace safety, continuous learning, and comprehensive documentation. We are dedicated to fostering safe and efficient work environments through expert guidance and innovative solutions.

Serve as a key administrative support resource for consultants and remote staff, ensuring they have the information, resources, scheduling support, and coordination they need to work effectively. Provide proactive assistance with day\-to\-day administrative needs, meetings, travel, communications, and other operational tasks to help keep the team organized, connected, and moving forward.

jobs.title: Manager, Partner Experience & Onboarding - 1430
jobs.description:
**About Fetch:**  

Fetch is a fast\-growing, venture\-backed company transforming the way multifamily communities manage essential amenities. Founded to solve the challenges of package delivery, Fetch has expanded its offerings into four core services: **Package Delivery**, **Valet Trash**, **Fetch Market**, and **Fetch Storage**.  

  

From our local facilities, we ensure secure, convenient, direct\-to\-door delivery for residents while streamlining operations for property teams. Our valet trash service provides simple, community\-wide waste solutions. Fetch Market offers direct\-to\-door delivery of everyday essentials, giving residents unparalleled convenience. Fetch Storage extends our mission by offering secure, flexible storage options tailored to multifamily living.  

  

Operating in communities across the U.S., we are tackling complex logistical challenges every day, from last\-mile delivery to amenity innovation, while creating seamless living experiences for residents and measurable value for property managers and owners. With substantial growth ahead, Fetch continues to shape the future of multifamily living by combining technology, logistics, and hospitality into one cohesive platform.



### **Our Opportunity:**


We’re hiring a Manager of Partner Experience \& Onboarding to own how Fetch attracts, onboards, and retains service partners who power our network. This role covers both Delivery Partners on the package side and Trash Service Partners on the valet trash side of the business, across every market we operate in. In this role you will own the strategy, the outcomes, and the quality of the experience a partner has from the moment they find us, through their first block, and every block after that. You decide where we source, how recruitment dollars are spent market by market, what a healthy funnel looks like, and where the onboarding workflow needs to change. You lead the team who executes against that plan. Success looks like consistent schedule fill, partners who move through onboarding without getting stuck, and service partners who think highly enough of Fetch to keep coming back for more work.### **What you’ll deliver on the job:**


* Own the end\-to\-end sourcing strategy for Service Partners: where we list, what we spend on recruitment, and how that spend is localized market by market so application volume matches the real capacity needs of each market
* Own the metrics that define a healthy funnel, including application volume by market, conversion rate through each stage, cost per applicant, cost per activation, and time to first block, and drive every one of them in the right direction
* Own sustained fill rates across the network, and partner with operations leadership early and directly whenever coverage is at risk in a market
* Own the onboarding and recruitment workflows end\-to\-end—optimizing technical efficiency, calibrating screening friction to balance quality and conversion, and leading a targeted multi\-channel communications strategy.
* Take a holistic view of the full service partner experience, from application to first block to ongoing work, covering first\-day experience, pay transparency, the in\-app experience, and support responsiveness, so that partners view Fetch positively, come back for more blocks, and stay on the platform long term
* Partner closely with Operations leadership to ensure they feel supported, identify the root cause of fill related issues and develop a recovery plan for each team as needed
* Create sustainable feedback loops to consistently evaluate and improve the DP experience, and the ability to report on those findings to leadership in a clear and concise manner
* Apply strong critical thinking when conversion, fill, or retention degrades: run root cause analysis to find the true driver rather than the symptom, and build a durable fix instead of a temporary patch
* Lead, coach, and develop the specialists reporting into this role, setting their priorities and raising the ceiling on what this function can deliver
**What we’ll deliver on:**
* **Competitive Compensation** – Your expertise and impact are recognized and rewarded
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package** – Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for you and your family
* **Plan for Your Future** – 401(k) plus AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability coverage
* **Unlimited PTO** – Take the time you need to recharge and bring your best self to work
* **Work That Makes an Impact** – Help shape the future of our operations, teams, and growth

  

At Fetch, we are always looking for awesome people to join our growing team. If you think you’re the right fit for this position, apply today. We’d love to hear from you! *Fetch is an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will be considered without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, disabilities, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


Remote


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Remote


**Department**
--------------


ProductProduct Management


  
### **About You**


You are a technically fluent, customer\-obsessed PM who gets energized by removing friction from developer workflows. You have a strong instinct for what makes integrations feel fast and safe, and you know how to balance developer needs with long\-term product maintainability. You bring systems thinking to SDK and tracking decisions, hold a high bar for integration correctness and reliability, and are energized by the challenge of reducing time\-to\-value for the teams and customers who depend on you.

  

### **About Us**

Constructor is the next\-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in\-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.


Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.


We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.


Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019\. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.


### **About the Position**


As the PM for Customer Developer Experience \+ Customer Data Integrations, you will own the end\-to\-end integration journey for Constructor's customers and SIs — from first setup through long\-term adoption. Your north star is time\-to\-value: making it fast, correct, and reliable for any team to integrate with Constructor and start getting results.


You will span two tightly connected surfaces:


* CDX — SDKs, UI libraries, integration patterns, docs, and the extensibility model that lets customers build on Constructor without accumulating hidden complexity.
* CDI — tracking/instrumentation, data attributes, event validation tooling, and the reliability \+ correctness of the data flows that power Constructor's AI.

* Define and drive a roadmap that measurably reduces integration time, defects, and escalations.
* Improve integration correctness for key tracking flows (search PDP conversion, sponsored click tracking, etc.) by reducing common failure modes and adding robust validation and diagnostics.
* Build and evolve validation and debugging tooling that empowers customers, Solutions Engineers, and Customer Success to self\-serve faster.
* Define clear support and capability boundaries to reduce high\-visibility escalations and improve customer predictability.
* Partner with Engineering, Solutions/CS, and other Product teams to sequence work, de\-risk launches, and ensure new capabilities ship integration\-ready.

Define and report a CDX\+CDI KPI stack (time\-to\-first\-value, adoption, defect rate, escalation volume, doc findability) and drive continuous improvement.

  

**Requirements**

* 3\+ years of product management experience shipping developer\-facing or integration\-heavy products — such as SDKs, APIs, web tracking/instrumentation, data pipelines, or developer tooling.

* Track record of strong cross\-functional collaboration: aligning Engineering, Customer Success, Solutions, and other Product teams on priorities and support boundaries.
* Comfort defining metrics and making decisions with imperfect data; experience building and reporting product health dashboards.

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033\. * Ability to complete assigned deliverables on time, with a proactive approach to surfacing risks and requesting guidance when needed.

jobs.description:
Contact center experience is a requirement for this role, banking experience is a plus. Candidates must be local to the Sacramento, CA area.
  
  

**Job Title:** Contact Center MSR II
  
**Status:** Non\-exempt
  
**Reports to:** Sup \- Contact Center
  
**Department:** Member Service Contact Center
  
**Job Code:** 1104
  
**Pay Range:** $22\.50 \- $25\.00/HR
  
**Location:** Remote in Sacramento, CA area
  
  

**WHO WE ARE:**  

Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member\-owned, not\-for\-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.
  
  

**WHO YOU ARE:**  

You are a member\-focused financial services professional who thrives in a fast\-paced contact center environment and is passionate about delivering exceptional service. You take ownership of member interactions, build lasting relationships, and are committed to upholding compliance standards while living Golden 1's Core Values.
  
  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**  

* Demonstrates advanced Credit Union knowledge, ability to resolve complex issues and escalations with minimum guidance.
* Learn and retain an exceptional working knowledge of products and services.
* Meet and achieve established performance standards commensurate to grade level, with phone efficiency and quality in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrates understanding of member needs, concerns and frustrations and respond by demonstrating care, concern and an appropriate sense of urgency.
* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of state and federal laws and regulations related to credit union compliance including bank secrecy and anti\-money laundering laws appropriate to the position.
* Demonstrate superior product knowledge recommending products/services to meet the member’s needs.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve basic and complex member concerns, as well as process and complete member transactions in a timely and efficient manner.
* Identify and report fraudulent activity to prevent potential loss to Credit Union.
* Update member and Credit Union account information efficiently and accurately.
* Educate member on products in an effort to retain and enhance member loyalty.
* Maintains ownership with the majority of their calls, requiring minimal guidance from Support.
* Ability to de\-escalate situations, looking from several points of view and applying good judgement and critical thinking to resolve the situation.
* Assist members with Online/Mobile Banking complex issues and Mobile Wallet set\-up.
* Ability to open Sub shares.
* Complete Regulatory Training Modules as required.
* Model Golden 1 core values.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**QUALIFICIATIONS AND PREFERENCES:**  

* H.S. Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required
* Some college preferred
* 1\+ years customer service experience in a contact center environment required
* 2\+ years financial services experience required
* Member relationship building experience preferred


**WHY JOIN US:**  

Golden 1 Credit Union provides its employees a market\-competitive and internally equitable total rewards compensation package through a variety of programs. These programs are designed to attract, motivate, and retain employees that drive and support the achievement of Our Mission, Vision, and Strategic Goals. The Credit Union is committed a total rewards philosophy built on; a comprehensive compensation package, well\-being and work\-life balance, career development and growth, rewards and recognition, and a commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. We believe in fostering a workplace where every employee is recognized, valued, and motivated to contribute their best.
